===== supabase\setup.sql =====
-- =====================================================================
-- Shree Krishna Enterprises | Chapter 2 | 0001 schema
-- Tables, constraints, indexes, triggers. RLS is in 0002.
-- =====================================================================

create or replace function public.set_updated_at() returns trigger
language plpgsql as $$
begin
  new.updated_at = now();
  return new;
end $$;

-- ---------- Roles and profiles ----------
create table public.roles (
  key text primary key,
  label text not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table public.profiles (
  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  full_name text,
  phone text,
  role text not null default 'customer' references public.roles(key),
  is_active boolean not null default true,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create or replace function public.is_admin() returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles p
    where p.id = auth.uid() and p.is_active and p.role in ('admin', 'super_admin')
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.is_super_admin() returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles p
    where p.id = auth.uid() and p.is_active and p.role = 'super_admin'
  );
$$;

-- New sign-ups always become 'customer'. Admins are promoted manually (see README).
create or replace function public.handle_new_user() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, full_name)
  values (new.id, nullif(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name', ''));
  return new;
end $$;

create trigger on_auth_user_created
  after insert on auth.users
  for each row execute function public.handle_new_user();

-- Nobody can change roles or deactivate accounts from the app unless super admin.
-- (The SQL editor has no logged-in user, so it is still allowed: that is how the first admin is created.)
create or replace function public.protect_profile_privileges() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if auth.uid() is not null and not public.is_super_admin() then
    if new.role is distinct from old.role or new.is_active is distinct from old.is_active then
      raise exception 'Only a super admin can change roles or account status';
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;

create trigger protect_profile_privileges
  before update on public.profiles
  for each row execute function public.protect_profile_privileges();

-- ---------- Business settings (single row, public-safe fields only) ----------
create table public.business_settings (
  id boolean primary key default true check (id),
  business_name text not null default 'Shree Krishna Enterprises',
  tagline text not null default 'Transforming Spaces with Beautiful POP & PVC Designs',
  phone text check (phone is null or phone ~ '^[+0-9][0-9 -]{5,19}$'),
  whatsapp_number text check (whatsapp_number is null or whatsapp_number ~ '^[0-9]{10,15}$'),
  email text check (email is null or email ~* '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'),
  address text,
  map_embed_url text check (map_embed_url is null or map_embed_url like 'https://www.google.com/maps/embed%'),
  working_hours text,
  seo_title text,
  seo_description text,
  og_image_path text,
  -- Optional features, switched on/off from admin.
  features jsonb not null default '{
    "before_after": true, "faq": true, "favourites": true,
    "video_gallery": false, "referral": false, "seasonal_offers": false,
    "estimator": false, "customer_accounts": false
  }'::jsonb,
  -- Estimator stays off until real rates are entered. null = not set.
  estimator_rates jsonb not null default '{"pop_per_sqft": null, "pvc_per_sqft": null}'::jsonb,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

-- Private settings: never readable by the public.
create table public.private_settings (
  id boolean primary key default true check (id),
  notification_email text check (notification_email is null or notification_email ~* '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'),
  email_notifications_enabled boolean not null default false,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

-- ---------- Catalogue ----------
create table public.service_areas (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  name text not null unique,
  is_active boolean not null default true,
  sort_order int not null default 0,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table public.services (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  slug text not null unique check (slug ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$'),
  title text not null,
  short_description text,
  description text,
  cover_image_path text,
  is_published boolean not null default false,
  sort_order int not null default 0,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table public.design_categories (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  slug text not null unique check (slug ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$'),
  name text not null,
  kind text not null default 'other' check (kind in ('service', 'room', 'type', 'style', 'other')),
  sort_order int not null default 0,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table public.designs (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  slug text not null unique check (slug ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$'),
  title text not null,
  description text,
  service_id uuid references public.services(id) on delete set null,
  cover_image_path text,
  is_published boolean not null default false,
  is_featured boolean not null default false,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index designs_service_idx on public.designs(service_id);
create index designs_published_idx on public.designs(is_published, created_at desc);

create table public.design_category_links (
  design_id uuid not null references public.designs(id) on delete cascade,
  category_id uuid not null references public.design_categories(id) on delete cascade,

create index design_category_links_category_idx on public.design_category_links(category_id);

create table public.design_images (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),

  storage_path text not null,
  alt_text text,
  sort_order int not null default 0,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index design_images_design_idx on public.design_images(design_id, sort_order);

create table public.projects (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  slug text not null unique check (slug ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$'),
  title text not null,
  location text,
  service_id uuid references public.services(id) on delete set null,
  description text,
  completed_on date,
  video_url text check (video_url is null or video_url ~* '^https://'),
  is_published boolean not null default false,
  is_featured boolean not null default false,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index projects_service_idx on public.projects(service_id);
create index projects_published_idx on public.projects(is_published, completed_on desc);

create table public.project_images (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  project_id uuid not null references public.projects(id) on delete cascade,
  storage_path text not null,
  kind text not null default 'gallery' check (kind in ('gallery', 'before', 'after')),
  alt_text text,
  sort_order int not null default 0,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index project_images_project_idx on public.project_images(project_id, sort_order);

-- Reference images. Cannot be published until usage permission is confirmed.
create table public.inspiration_sources (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  title text not null,
  image_path text,
  embed_url text check (embed_url is null or embed_url ~* '^https://([a-z0-9-]+\.)?pinterest\.[a-z.]+/'),
  license_type text not null check (license_type in ('own_image', 'licensed', 'permitted_embed', 'permission_granted')),
  source_name text,
  source_url text check (source_url is null or source_url ~* '^https?://'),
  attribution text,
  permission_notes text,
  usage_permission_confirmed boolean not null default false,
  is_published boolean not null default false,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint inspiration_publish_rules check (
    not is_published
    or (usage_permission_confirmed and (image_path is not null or embed_url is not null))
  )
);
create index inspiration_published_idx on public.inspiration_sources(is_published);

-- ---------- Enquiries, quotations ----------
create sequence public.enquiry_seq;
create sequence public.quotation_seq;

create table public.enquiries (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  ref_code text not null unique default ('SKE-' || lpad(nextval('public.enquiry_seq')::text, 5, '0')),
  kind text not null default 'general' check (kind in ('quotation', 'custom_design', 'design', 'project', 'general')),
  status text not null default 'new' check (status in ('new', 'contacted', 'site_visit', 'quotation_sent', 'confirmed', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'closed')),
  user_id uuid references auth.users(id) on delete set null,
  name text not null check (char_length(name) between 2 and 100),
  phone text not null check (phone ~ '^[+0-9][0-9 -]{5,19}$'),
  email text check (email is null or email ~* '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'),
  address text check (address is null or char_length(address) <= 500),
  service_type text,
  room_type text,
  length_ft numeric(7,2) check (length_ft is null or (length_ft > 0 and length_ft < 1000)),
  width_ft numeric(7,2) check (width_ft is null or (width_ft > 0 and width_ft < 1000)),
  budget_range text,
  style text,
  description text check (description is null or char_length(description) <= 4000),
  preferred_visit_date date,
  preferred_location text,
  design_id uuid references public.designs(id) on delete set null,
  project_id uuid references public.projects(id) on delete set null,
  privacy_consent boolean not null check (privacy_consent),
  admin_notes text,
  follow_up_on date,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index enquiries_status_idx on public.enquiries(status, created_at desc);
create index enquiries_kind_idx on public.enquiries(kind);
create index enquiries_user_idx on public.enquiries(user_id);
create index enquiries_follow_up_idx on public.enquiries(follow_up_on) where follow_up_on is not null;

create table public.enquiry_images (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  enquiry_id uuid not null references public.enquiries(id) on delete cascade,

  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index enquiry_images_enquiry_idx on public.enquiry_images(enquiry_id);

create table public.enquiry_status_history (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),

);
create index enquiry_history_enquiry_idx on public.enquiry_status_history(enquiry_id, created_at);

create table public.quotations (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),

  scope text,
  amount numeric(12,2) check (amount is null or amount >= 0),
  valid_until date,
  notes text,
  created_by uuid references auth.users(id) on delete set null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index quotations_enquiry_idx on public.quotations(enquiry_id);

  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index notifications_unread_idx on public.notifications(is_read, created_at desc);

create table public.admin_activity_logs (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  admin_id uuid references auth.users(id) on delete set null,
  action text not null,
  entity_type text,
  entity_id uuid,
  details jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index admin_logs_created_idx on public.admin_activity_logs(created_at desc);

-- Used by server code to rate-limit public form submissions.
create table public.rate_limits (
  key text primary key,
  window_start timestamptz not null default now(),
  hits int not null default 1
);

-- ---------- updated_at triggers ----------
do $$
declare t text;
begin
  foreach t in array array[
    'profiles','business_settings','private_settings','service_areas','services',
    'design_categories','designs','projects','inspiration_sources','enquiries',
    'quotations','reviews','job_roles','worker_applications','faqs'
  ] loop
    execute format(
      'create trigger set_updated_at before update on public.%I for each row execute function public.set_updated_at()', t);
  end loop;
end $$;

-- ---------- Enquiry status history ----------
create or replace function public.log_enquiry_status_change() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if new.status is distinct from old.status then
    insert into public.enquiry_status_history (enquiry_id, from_status, to_status, changed_by)
    values (new.id, old.status, new.status, auth.uid());
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;

create trigger log_enquiry_status_change
  after update of status on public.enquiries
  for each row execute function public.log_enquiry_status_change();

-- ---------- Admin notifications ----------
create or replace function public.notify_new_enquiry() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  insert into public.notifications (type, title, body, link, entity_id)
  values (
    case when new.kind = 'quotation' then 'quotation' else 'enquiry' end,
    case when new.kind = 'quotation' then 'New quotation request' else 'New enquiry' end,
    new.name || ' (' || new.ref_code || ')',
    '/admin/enquiries/' || new.id,
    new.id
  );
  return new;
end $$;
create trigger notify_new_enquiry after insert on public.enquiries
  for each row execute function public.notify_new_enquiry();

create or replace function public.notify_new_review() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  insert into public.notifications (type, title, body, link, entity_id)
  values ('review', 'New review to moderate', new.reviewer_name || ': ' || new.rating || ' stars', '/admin/reviews', new.id);
  return new;
end $$;
create trigger notify_new_review after insert on public.reviews
  for each row execute function public.notify_new_review();

language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  insert into public.notifications (type, title, body, link, entity_id)
  values ('application', 'New worker application', new.name || ' for ' || new.role_title, '/admin/applications', new.id);
  return new;
end $$;
create trigger notify_new_application after insert on public.worker_applications
  for each row execute function public.notify_new_application();

-- ---------- Rate limit helper (server only) ----------
create or replace function public.check_rate_limit(p_key text, p_max int, p_window_seconds int)
returns boolean language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare v_hits int;
begin
  insert into public.rate_limits as r (key, window_start, hits)
  values (p_key, now(), 1)
  on conflict (key) do update set
    hits = case when r.window_start < now() - make_interval(secs => p_window_seconds) then 1 else r.hits + 1 end,
    window_start = case when r.window_start < now() - make_interval(secs => p_window_seconds) then now() else r.window_start end
  returning r.hits into v_hits;
  return v_hits <= p_max;
end $$;

revoke execute on function public.check_rate_limit(text, int, int) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.check_rate_limit(text, int, int) to service_role;

revoke execute on function public.handle_new_user() from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke execute on function public.log_enquiry_status_change() from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke execute on function public.notify_new_enquiry() from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke execute on function public.notify_new_review() from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke execute on function public.notify_new_application() from public, anon, authenticated;
-- =====================================================================
-- Shree Krishna Enterprises | Chapter 2 | 0002 Row Level Security
-- Rules:
--  * Public: read published/approved content only. No direct writes.
--  * Public form submissions go through Next.js server actions (validated,
--    rate-limited) that use the service-role key on the server only.
--  * Logged-in customers: only their own rows.
--  * Admins (verified in the database via is_admin()): everything.
-- =====================================================================

-- Turn on RLS for every table in public.
do $$
declare r record;
begin
  for r in select tablename from pg_tables where schemaname = 'public' loop
    execute format('alter table public.%I enable row level security', r.tablename);
  end loop;
end $$;

-- ---------- Admin: full access (not for rate_limits, which is server-only) ----------
do $$
declare t text;
begin
  foreach t in array array[
    'roles','business_settings','private_settings','service_areas','services','design_categories',
    'designs','design_category_links','design_images','projects','project_images','inspiration_sources',
    'enquiries','enquiry_images','enquiry_status_history','quotations','reviews','review_images',
    'job_roles','worker_applications','worker_application_images','favourites','faqs',
    'notifications','admin_activity_logs'
  ] loop
    execute format(
      'create policy "admin full access" on public.%I for all to authenticated
         using ((select public.is_admin())) with check ((select public.is_admin()))', t);
  end loop;
end $$;

-- Logs are append-only, even for admins.
drop policy "admin full access" on public.admin_activity_logs;
create policy "admin read logs" on public.admin_activity_logs
  for select to authenticated using ((select public.is_admin()));
create policy "admin write logs" on public.admin_activity_logs
  for insert to authenticated with check ((select public.is_admin()));

-- rate_limits: no policies at all, and no grants. Only the service role touches it.
revoke all on public.rate_limits from anon, authenticated;

-- ---------- Profiles ----------
create policy "read own profile" on public.profiles
  for select to authenticated using (id = (select auth.uid()));
create policy "admin read profiles" on public.profiles
  for select to authenticated using ((select public.is_admin()));
create policy "update own profile" on public.profiles
  for update to authenticated
  using (id = (select auth.uid())) with check (id = (select auth.uid()));
create policy "super admin update profiles" on public.profiles
  for update to authenticated
  using ((select public.is_super_admin())) with check ((select public.is_super_admin()));

-- ---------- Public read: published content only ----------
create policy "public read settings" on public.business_settings
  for select to anon, authenticated using (true);
create policy "public read active areas" on public.service_areas
  for select to anon, authenticated using (is_active);
create policy "public read published services" on public.services
  for select to anon, authenticated using (is_published);
create policy "public read categories" on public.design_categories
  for select to anon, authenticated using (true);
create policy "public read published designs" on public.designs
  for select to anon, authenticated using (is_published);
create policy "public read design category links" on public.design_category_links
  for select to anon, authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.designs d where d.id = design_id and d.is_published));
create policy "public read design images" on public.design_images
  for select to anon, authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.designs d where d.id = design_id and d.is_published));
create policy "public read published projects" on public.projects
  for select to anon, authenticated using (is_published);
create policy "public read project images" on public.project_images
  for select to anon, authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.projects p where p.id = project_id and p.is_published));
create policy "public read published inspiration" on public.inspiration_sources
  for select to anon, authenticated using (is_published and usage_permission_confirmed);
create policy "public read approved reviews" on public.reviews
  for select to anon, authenticated using (status = 'approved');
create policy "public read approved review images" on public.review_images
  for select to anon, authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.reviews r where r.id = review_id and r.status = 'approved'));
create policy "public read active job roles" on public.job_roles
  for select to anon, authenticated using (is_active);
create policy "public read published faqs" on public.faqs
  for select to anon, authenticated using (is_published);

-- ---------- Logged-in customers: own rows only ----------
create policy "customer read own enquiries" on public.enquiries
  for select to authenticated using (user_id = (select auth.uid()));
create policy "customer create own enquiries" on public.enquiries
  for insert to authenticated
  with check (user_id = (select auth.uid()) and status = 'new' and privacy_consent);

create policy "customer read own enquiry images" on public.enquiry_images
  for select to authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.enquiries e where e.id = enquiry_id and e.user_id = (select auth.uid())));

create policy "customer read own enquiry history" on public.enquiry_status_history
  for select to authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.enquiries e where e.id = enquiry_id and e.user_id = (select auth.uid())));

-- Customers only see quotations once the admin has sent them.
create policy "customer read own sent quotations" on public.quotations
  for select to authenticated
  using (
    status <> 'draft'
    and exists (select 1 from public.enquiries e where e.id = enquiry_id and e.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
  );

create policy "customer read own reviews" on public.reviews
  for select to authenticated using (user_id = (select auth.uid()));
create policy "customer create own reviews" on public.reviews
  for insert to authenticated
  with check (
    user_id = (select auth.uid()) and status = 'pending' and not is_verified and privacy_consent
  );

create policy "customer manage own favourites" on public.favourites
  for all to authenticated
  using (user_id = (select auth.uid())) with check (user_id = (select auth.uid()));

-- Sequences used in column defaults must be usable by customers inserting enquiries.
grant usage on sequence public.enquiry_seq to authenticated;
-- =====================================================================
-- Shree Krishna Enterprises | Chapter 2 | 0003 storage buckets
--  public-media     : PUBLIC. Admin-uploaded project/design/service photos. 5 MB, images only.
--  customer-uploads : PRIVATE. Customer room photos, worker portfolio photos. 8 MB, images only.
--                     Only admins (and server code with the service role) can read it.
-- =====================================================================

insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public, file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types)
values
  ('public-media', 'public-media', true, 5242880,
    array['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/avif']),
  ('customer-uploads', 'customer-uploads', false, 8388608,
    array['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/heic'])
on conflict (id) do update
  set public = excluded.public,
      file_size_limit = excluded.file_size_limit,
      allowed_mime_types = excluded.allowed_mime_types;

-- Public bucket files are served by URL without any policy, so there is deliberately
-- NO select policy: nobody can list the bucket. Only admins manage files.
create policy "admin manage public-media" on storage.objects
  for all to authenticated
  using (bucket_id = 'public-media' and (select public.is_admin()))
  with check (bucket_id = 'public-media' and (select public.is_admin()));

create policy "admin manage customer-uploads" on storage.objects
  for all to authenticated
  using (bucket_id = 'customer-uploads' and (select public.is_admin()))
  with check (bucket_id = 'customer-uploads' and (select public.is_admin()));

-- Customer uploads are written by server actions (service role) after validation,
-- so there is no anonymous or customer insert policy on purpose.

create or replace function public.set_updated_at() returns trigger
language plpgsql as $$
begin
  new.updated_at = now();
  return new;
end $$;

-- ---------- Roles and profiles ----------
create table public.roles (
  key text primary key,
  label text not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table public.profiles (
  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  full_name text,
  phone text,
  role text not null default 'customer' references public.roles(key),
  is_active boolean not null default true,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create or replace function public.is_admin() returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles p
    where p.id = auth.uid() and p.is_active and p.role in ('admin', 'super_admin')
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.is_super_admin() returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles p
    where p.id = auth.uid() and p.is_active and p.role = 'super_admin'
  );
$$;

-- New sign-ups always become 'customer'. Admins are promoted manually (see README).
create or replace function public.handle_new_user() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, full_name)
  values (new.id, nullif(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name', ''));
  return new;
end $$;

create trigger on_auth_user_created
  after insert on auth.users
  for each row execute function public.handle_new_user();

-- Nobody can change roles or deactivate accounts from the app unless super admin.
-- (The SQL editor has no logged-in user, so it is still allowed: that is how the first admin is created.)
create or replace function public.protect_profile_privileges() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if auth.uid() is not null and not public.is_super_admin() then
    if new.role is distinct from old.role or new.is_active is distinct from old.is_active then
      raise exception 'Only a super admin can change roles or account status';
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;

create trigger protect_profile_privileges
  before update on public.profiles
  for each row execute function public.protect_profile_privileges();

  id boolean primary key default true check (id),
  business_name text not null default 'Shree Krishna Enterprises',
  tagline text not null default 'Transforming Spaces with Beautiful POP & PVC Designs',
  phone text check (phone is null or phone ~ '^[+0-9][0-9 -]{5,19}$'),
  whatsapp_number text check (whatsapp_number is null or whatsapp_number ~ '^[0-9]{10,15}$'),
  email text check (email is null or email ~* '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'),
  address text,
  map_embed_url text check (map_embed_url is null or map_embed_url like 'https://www.google.com/maps/embed%'),
  working_hours text,
  seo_title text,
  seo_description text,
  og_image_path text,
  -- Optional features, switched on/off from admin.
  features jsonb not null default '{
    "before_after": true, "faq": true, "favourites": true,
    "video_gallery": false, "referral": false, "seasonal_offers": false,
    "estimator": false, "customer_accounts": false
  }'::jsonb,
  -- Estimator stays off until real rates are entered. null = not set.
  estimator_rates jsonb not null default '{"pop_per_sqft": null, "pvc_per_sqft": null}'::jsonb,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),

);

  note text,
  changed_by uuid references auth.users(id) on delete set null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index enquiry_history_enquiry_idx on public.enquiry_status_history(enquiry_id, created_at);

  valid_until date,
  notes text,

-- ---------- updated_at triggers ----------
do $$
declare t text;
begin
  foreach t in array array[
    'profiles','business_settings','private_settings','service_areas','services',
    'design_categories','designs','projects','inspiration_sources','enquiries',
    'quotations','reviews','job_roles','worker_applications','faqs'
  ] loop
    execute format(
      'create trigger set_updated_at before update on public.%I for each row execute function public.set_updated_at()', t);
  end loop;
end $$;

-- ---------- Enquiry status history ----------
create or replace function public.log_enquiry_status_change() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if new.status is distinct from old.status then
    insert into public.enquiry_status_history (enquiry_id, from_status, to_status, changed_by)
    values (new.id, old.status, new.status, auth.uid());
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;

create trigger log_enquiry_status_change
  after update of status on public.enquiries
  for each row execute function public.log_enquiry_status_change();

-- ---------- Admin notifications ----------
create or replace function public.notify_new_enquiry() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  insert into public.notifications (type, title, body, link, entity_id)
  values (
    case when new.kind = 'quotation' then 'quotation' else 'enquiry' end,
    case when new.kind = 'quotation' then 'New quotation request' else 'New enquiry' end,
    new.name || ' (' || new.ref_code || ')',
    '/admin/enquiries/' || new.id,
    new.id
  );
  return new;
end $$;
create trigger notify_new_enquiry after insert on public.enquiries
  for each row execute function public.notify_new_enquiry();

end $$;
create trigger notify_new_review after insert on public.reviews

begin

  values ('application', 'New worker application', new.name || ' for ' || new.role_title, '/admin/applications', new.id);
  return new;
end $$;
create trigger notify_new_application after insert on public.worker_applications
  for each row execute function public.notify_new_application();

-- ---------- Rate limit helper (server only) ----------
create or replace function public.check_rate_limit(p_key text, p_max int, p_window_seconds int)
returns boolean language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare v_hits int;
begin
  insert into public.rate_limits as r (key, window_start, hits)
  values (p_key, now(), 1)
  on conflict (key) do update set
    hits = case when r.window_start < now() - make_interval(secs => p_window_seconds) then 1 else r.hits + 1 end,
    window_start = case when r.window_start < now() - make_interval(secs => p_window_seconds) then now() else r.window_start end
  returning r.hits into v_hits;
  return v_hits <= p_max;
end $$;

revoke execute on function public.check_rate_limit(text, int, int) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.check_rate_limit(text, int, int) to service_role;

revoke execute on function public.handle_new_user() from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke execute on function public.log_enquiry_status_change() from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke execute on function public.notify_new_enquiry() from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke execute on function public.notify_new_review() from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke execute on function public.notify_new_application() from public, anon, authenticated;

===== supabase\migrations\0002_rls.sql =====
-- =====================================================================
-- Shree Krishna Enterprises | Chapter 2 | 0002 Row Level Security
-- Rules:
--  * Public: read published/approved content only. No direct writes.
--  * Public form submissions go through Next.js server actions (validated,
--    rate-limited) that use the service-role key on the server only.
--  * Logged-in customers: only their own rows.
--  * Admins (verified in the database via is_admin()): everything.
-- =====================================================================

-- Turn on RLS for every table in public.
do $$
declare r record;
begin
  for r in select tablename from pg_tables where schemaname = 'public' loop
    execute format('alter table public.%I enable row level security', r.tablename);
  end loop;
end $$;

-- ---------- Admin: full access (not for rate_limits, which is server-only) ----------
do $$
declare t text;
begin
  foreach t in array array[
    'roles','business_settings','private_settings','service_areas','services','design_categories',
    'designs','design_category_links','design_images','projects','project_images','inspiration_sources',
    'enquiries','enquiry_images','enquiry_status_history','quotations','reviews','review_images',
    'job_roles','worker_applications','worker_application_images','favourites','faqs',
    'notifications','admin_activity_logs'
  ] loop
    execute format(
      'create policy "admin full access" on public.%I for all to authenticated
         using ((select public.is_admin())) with check ((select public.is_admin()))', t);
  end loop;
end $$;

-- Logs are append-only, even for admins.
drop policy "admin full access" on public.admin_activity_logs;
create policy "admin read logs" on public.admin_activity_logs
  for select to authenticated using ((select public.is_admin()));
create policy "admin write logs" on public.admin_activity_logs
  for insert to authenticated with check ((select public.is_admin()));

-- rate_limits: no policies at all, and no grants. Only the service role touches it.
revoke all on public.rate_limits from anon, authenticated;

-- ---------- Profiles ----------
create policy "read own profile" on public.profiles
  for select to authenticated using (id = (select auth.uid()));
create policy "admin read profiles" on public.profiles
  for select to authenticated using ((select public.is_admin()));
create policy "update own profile" on public.profiles
  for update to authenticated
  using (id = (select auth.uid())) with check (id = (select auth.uid()));
create policy "super admin update profiles" on public.profiles
  for update to authenticated
  using ((select public.is_super_admin())) with check ((select public.is_super_admin()));

-- ---------- Public read: published content only ----------
create policy "public read settings" on public.business_settings
  for select to anon, authenticated using (true);
create policy "public read active areas" on public.service_areas
  for select to anon, authenticated using (is_active);
create policy "public read published services" on public.services
  for select to anon, authenticated using (is_published);
create policy "public read categories" on public.design_categories
  for select to anon, authenticated using (true);
create policy "public read published designs" on public.designs
  for select to anon, authenticated using (is_published);
create policy "public read design category links" on public.design_category_links
  for select to anon, authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.designs d where d.id = design_id and d.is_published));
create policy "public read design images" on public.design_images
  for select to anon, authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.designs d where d.id = design_id and d.is_published));
create policy "public read published projects" on public.projects
  for select to anon, authenticated using (is_published);
create policy "public read project images" on public.project_images
  for select to anon, authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.projects p where p.id = project_id and p.is_published));
create policy "public read published inspiration" on public.inspiration_sources
  for select to anon, authenticated using (is_published and usage_permission_confirmed);
create policy "public read approved reviews" on public.reviews
  for select to anon, authenticated using (status = 'approved');
create policy "public read approved review images" on public.review_images
  for select to anon, authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.reviews r where r.id = review_id and r.status = 'approved'));
create policy "public read active job roles" on public.job_roles
  for select to anon, authenticated using (is_active);
create policy "public read published faqs" on public.faqs
  for select to anon, authenticated using (is_published);

-- ---------- Logged-in customers: own rows only ----------
create policy "customer read own enquiries" on public.enquiries
  for select to authenticated using (user_id = (select auth.uid()));
create policy "customer create own enquiries" on public.enquiries
  for insert to authenticated
  with check (user_id = (select auth.uid()) and status = 'new' and privacy_consent);

create policy "customer read own enquiry images" on public.enquiry_images
  for select to authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.enquiries e where e.id = enquiry_id and e.user_id = (select auth.uid())));

create policy "customer read own enquiry history" on public.enquiry_status_history
  for select to authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.enquiries e where e.id = enquiry_id and e.user_id = (select auth.uid())));

-- Customers only see quotations once the admin has sent them.
create policy "customer read own sent quotations" on public.quotations
  for select to authenticated
  using (
    status <> 'draft'
    and exists (select 1 from public.enquiries e where e.id = enquiry_id and e.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
  );

create policy "customer read own reviews" on public.reviews
  for select to authenticated using (user_id = (select auth.uid()));
create policy "customer create own reviews" on public.reviews
  for insert to authenticated
  with check (
    user_id = (select auth.uid()) and status = 'pending' and not is_verified and privacy_consent
  );

create policy "customer manage own favourites" on public.favourites
  for all to authenticated
  using (user_id = (select auth.uid())) with check (user_id = (select auth.uid()));

-- Sequences used in column defaults must be usable by customers inserting enquiries.
grant usage on sequence public.enquiry_seq to authenticated;

===== supabase\migrations\0003_storage.sql =====
-- =====================================================================
-- Shree Krishna Enterprises | Chapter 2 | 0003 storage buckets
--  public-media     : PUBLIC. Admin-uploaded project/design/service photos. 5 MB, images only.
--  customer-uploads : PRIVATE. Customer room photos, worker portfolio photos. 8 MB, images only.
--                     Only admins (and server code with the service role) can read it.
-- =====================================================================

insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public, file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types)
values
  ('public-media', 'public-media', true, 5242880,
    array['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/avif']),
  ('customer-uploads', 'customer-uploads', false, 8388608,
    array['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/heic'])
on conflict (id) do update
  set public = excluded.public,
      file_size_limit = excluded.file_size_limit,
      allowed_mime_types = excluded.allowed_mime_types;

-- Public bucket files are served by URL without any policy, so there is deliberately
-- NO select policy: nobody can list the bucket. Only admins manage files.
create policy "admin manage public-media" on storage.objects
  for all to authenticated
  using (bucket_id = 'public-media' and (select public.is_admin()))
  with check (bucket_id = 'public-media' and (select public.is_admin()));

create policy "admin manage customer-uploads" on storage.objects
  for all to authenticated
  using (bucket_id = 'customer-uploads' and (select public.is_admin()))
  with check (bucket_id = 'customer-uploads' and (select public.is_admin()));

-- Customer uploads are written by server actions (service role) after validation,
-- so there is no anonymous or customer insert policy on purpose.

===== src\proxy.ts =====
import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseEnv } from "@/lib/supabase/env";

/**
 * Runs only for /admin routes. It refreshes the login session and sends
 * logged-out visitors to the login page. This is a convenience layer:
 * the real checks are requireAdmin() on the server and RLS in the database.
 */
export async function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
  const { pathname } = request.nextUrl;
  const isLogin = pathname === "/admin/login";
  const env = getSupabaseEnv();

  const toLogin = () => {
    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
    url.pathname = "/admin/login";
    url.search = "";
    return NextResponse.redirect(url);
  };

  if (!env) return isLogin ? NextResponse.next() : toLogin();

  let response = NextResponse.next({ request });
  const supabase = createServerClient(env.url, env.anonKey, {
    cookies: {
      getAll: () => request.cookies.getAll(),
      setAll(list) {
        list.forEach(({ name, value }) => request.cookies.set(name, value));
        response = NextResponse.next({ request });
        list.forEach(({ name, value, options }) => response.cookies.set(name, value, options));
      },
    },
  });

  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!data.user && !isLogin) return toLogin();
  return response;
}

export const config = { matcher: ["/admin/:path*"] };

===== src\app\sitemap.ts =====
import type { MetadataRoute } from "next";
import { getBusinessSettings } from "@/lib/business-settings";
import { getSlugs } from "@/lib/content";

export const revalidate = 3600;

export default async function sitemap(): Promise<MetadataRoute.Sitemap> {
  const [settings, slugs] = await Promise.all([getBusinessSettings(), getSlugs()]);
  const base = settings.siteUrl;

  const statics = [
    "", "/about", "/services", "/projects", "/designs", "/inspiration", "/reviews", "/contact",
    "/quote", "/custom-design", "/join-our-team", "/privacy", "/terms",
    ...(settings.features.faq ? ["/faq"] : []),
  ].map((p) => ({ url: `${base}${p}` }));

  const dynamic = (prefix: string, rows: { slug: string; updated_at: string }[]) =>
    rows.map((r) => ({ url: `${base}${prefix}/${r.slug}`, lastModified: new Date(r.updated_at) }));

  return [
    ...statics,
    ...dynamic("/services", slugs.services),
    ...dynamic("/projects", slugs.projects),
    ...dynamic("/designs", slugs.designs),
  ];
}

      <SiteHeader name={settings.name} />

        {children}
      </main>
      <SiteFooter settings={settings} showFaq={showFaq} />
      <FloatingWhatsApp
        whatsappNumber={settings.whatsappNumber}
        siteUrl={settings.siteUrl}
      />
    </>
  );
}

===== src\app\(site)\designs\(list)\page.tsx =====
import Link from "next/link";
import { Search } from "lucide-react";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";
import { Section } from "@/components/layout/section";
import { DesignCard } from "@/components/shared/cards";
import { Pagination } from "@/components/shared/pagination";
import { WhatsAppLink } from "@/components/shared/contact-buttons";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/states/empty-state";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/states/error-state";
import { getBusinessSettings } from "@/lib/business-settings";
import { categoriesOf, getCategories, getDesigns } from "@/lib/content";
import { pageMetadata } from "@/lib/seo";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export const metadata = pageMetadata({
  title: "Design Gallery",
  description: "Browse POP and PVC ceiling and wall designs. Save the ones you like and ask us about them.",
  path: "/designs",
});

const PAGE_SIZE = 12;
const KIND_ORDER = ["service", "room", "type", "style", "other"] as const;
const KIND_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  service: "Material",
  room: "Room",
  type: "Type",
  style: "Style",
  other: "Other",
};

type SP = { q?: string; cat?: string | string[]; page?: string };
const toArray = (v: string | string[] | undefined) => (Array.isArray(v) ? v : v ? [v] : []);

function buildHref(cats: string[], q: string, page = 1) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  cats.forEach((c) => params.append("cat", c));
  if (q) params.set("q", q);
  if (page > 1) params.set("page", String(page));
  const qs = params.toString();
  return qs ? `/designs?${qs}` : "/designs";
}

export default async function DesignsPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<SP> }) {
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const q = (sp.q ?? "").trim().slice(0, 80);
  const requestedPage = Math.max(1, parseInt(sp.page ?? "1", 10) || 1);

  const [settings, designs, cats] = await Promise.all([getBusinessSettings(), getDesigns(), getCategories()]);

  const selected = toArray(sp.cat).filter((slug) => cats.data.some((c) => c.slug === slug));

  // Same group = "or" (POP or PVC), different groups = "and" (PVC and Bedroom).
  const byKind = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const slug of selected) {
    const kind = cats.data.find((c) => c.slug === slug)!.kind;
    byKind.set(kind, [...(byKind.get(kind) ?? []), slug]);
  }

  const needle = q.toLowerCase();
  const filtered = designs.data.filter((d) => {
    const have = categoriesOf(d).map((c) => c.slug);
    for (const slugs of byKind.values()) if (!slugs.some((s) => have.includes(s))) return false;
    if (needle && !`${d.title} ${d.description ?? ""}`.toLowerCase().includes(needle)) return false;
    return true;
  });

  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / PAGE_SIZE));
  const page = Math.min(requestedPage, totalPages);
  const pageItems = filtered.slice((page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE, page * PAGE_SIZE);
  const showFav = settings.features.favourites;
  const filtering = selected.length > 0 || q !== "";

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Design Gallery"
        description="Ideas for ceilings and walls in POP and PVC. Save your favourites and ask us about any design."
      />
      <Section>
        {designs.failed ? (
          <ErrorState />
        ) : designs.data.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            title="Designs will appear here soon"
            description="We are adding our design catalogue. Tell us what you have in mind on WhatsApp."
            action={<WhatsAppLink settings={settings} />}
          />
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="mb-8 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4">
              <form action="/designs" method="get" role="search" className="flex w-full max-w-md gap-2">
                {selected.map((c) => (
                  <input key={c} type="hidden" name="cat" value={c} />
                ))}
                <label htmlFor="q" className="sr-only">
                  Search designs
                </label>
                <Input id="q" name="q" defaultValue={q} placeholder="Search designs" />
                <Button type="submit" size="icon" aria-label="Search">
                  <Search />
                </Button>
              </form>
              {showFav ? (
                <Button asChild variant="ghost">
                  <Link href="/designs/saved">Saved designs</Link>
                </Button>
              ) : null}
            </div>

            <div className="mb-10 space-y-4">
              {KIND_ORDER.map((kind) => {
                const group = cats.data.filter((c) => c.kind === kind);
                if (group.length === 0) return null;
                return (
                  <div key={kind} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="w-20 text-sm text-stone">{KIND_LABEL[kind]}</span>
                    {group.map((c) => {
                      const on = selected.includes(c.slug);
                      const next = on ? selected.filter((s) => s !== c.slug) : [...selected, c.slug];
                      return (
                        <Link
                          key={c.id}
                          href={buildHref(next, q)}
                          aria-pressed={on}
                          className={cn(
                            "inline-flex h-11 items-center rounded-sm border px-4 text-[0.95rem]",
                            on ? "border-charcoal bg-charcoal text-warm-white" : "border-line hover:bg-beige",
                          )}
                        >
                          {c.name}
                        </Link>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
              {filtering ? (
                <Link href="/designs" className="inline-block text-stone underline hover:text-charcoal">
                  Clear filters
                </Link>
              ) : null}
            </div>

            <p className="mb-6 text-stone" role="status">
              {filtered.length} {filtered.length === 1 ? "design" : "designs"}
            </p>

            {filtered.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                title="No designs match these filters"
                description="Try removing a filter, or tell us what you want and we will suggest something."
                action={<WhatsAppLink settings={settings} />}
              />
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="grid gap-8 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
                  {pageItems.map((d) => (
                    <DesignCard key={d.id} design={d} showFavourite={showFav} />
                  ))}
                </div>
                <Pagination page={page} totalPages={totalPages} hrefFor={(n) => buildHref(selected, q, n)} />
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </Section>
    </>
  );
}

===== src\app\(site)\designs\saved\page.tsx =====

import { Section } from "@/components/layout/section";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/states/error-state";

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { DesignCard } from "@/components/shared/cards";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/states/empty-state";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useFavourites } from "@/lib/favourites";
import type { Design } from "@/lib/types";

export function SavedDesignsGrid({ designs }: { designs: Design[] }) {
  const saved = useFavourites();
  const shown = designs.filter((d) => saved.includes(d.slug));

  if (shown.length === 0) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        title="No saved designs yet"
        description="Tap the heart on any design to keep it here. Saved designs stay on this phone only."
        action={
          <Button asChild>
            <Link href="/designs">Browse designs</Link>
          </Button>
        }
      />
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-8 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
      {shown.map((d) => (
        <DesignCard key={d.id} design={d} showFavourite />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Section } from "@/components/layout/section";
import { DesignCard } from "@/components/shared/cards";
import { FavouriteButton } from "@/components/shared/favourite-button";
import { ItemImage } from "@/components/shared/item-image";
import { SectionHeading } from "@/components/shared/section-heading";
import { ShareButton } from "@/components/shared/share-button";
import { WhatsAppLink } from "@/components/shared/contact-buttons";
import { getBusinessSettings } from "@/lib/business-settings";
import { byOrder, categoriesOf, designCover, getDesign, getDesigns } from "@/lib/content";
import { publicMediaUrl } from "@/lib/storage";
import { pageMetadata } from "@/lib/seo";

export const revalidate = 60;

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const { data: design } = await getDesign(slug);
  if (!design) return { title: "Design not found" };
  return pageMetadata({
    title: design.title,
    description: design.description?.slice(0, 160) ?? `${design.title}: POP and PVC design by Shree Krishna Enterprises.`,
    path: `/designs/${design.slug}`,
    image: publicMediaUrl(designCover(design)?.path),
  });
}

export default async function DesignDetailPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const [settings, result] = await Promise.all([getBusinessSettings(), getDesign(slug)]);
  if (!result.data) notFound();
  const d = result.data;
  const path = `/designs/${d.slug}`;

  // All photos: cover first, then the rest without repeating the cover.
  const cover = designCover(d);
  const extra = byOrder(d.design_images ?? []).filter((i) => i.storage_path !== cover?.path);
  const photos = [
    ...(cover ? [{ id: "cover", path: cover.path, alt: cover.alt }] : []),
    ...extra.map((i) => ({ id: i.id, path: i.storage_path, alt: i.alt_text || d.title })),
  ];

  const cats = categoriesOf(d);
  const all = await getDesigns();
  const catSlugs = new Set(cats.map((c) => c.slug));
  const related = all.data
    .filter((o) => o.id !== d.id && categoriesOf(o).some((c) => catSlugs.has(c.slug)))
    .slice(0, 3);

  return (
    <>
      <Section>
        <Link href="/designs" className="text-stone underline hover:text-charcoal">
          All designs
        </Link>
        <div className="mt-6 grid gap-10 lg:grid-cols-[1.3fr_1fr]">
          <div>
            {photos.length === 0 ? (
              <ItemImage path={null} alt={d.title} className="aspect-[4/3]" />
            ) : (
              <ul className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                {photos.map((p, i) => (
                  <li key={p.id} className={i === 0 ? "sm:col-span-2" : ""}>
                    <ItemImage
                      path={p.path}
                      alt={p.alt}
                      className="aspect-[4/3]"
                      sizes={i === 0 ? "(min-width: 1024px) 60vw, 100vw" : "(min-width: 1024px) 30vw, 50vw"}
                      priority={i === 0}
                    />
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </div>

          <div>
            <h1 className="text-4xl text-charcoal sm:text-5xl">{d.title}</h1>
            {cats.length > 0 ? (
              <ul className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {cats.map((c) => (
                  <li key={c.id}>
                    <Link
                      href={`/designs?cat=${encodeURIComponent(c.slug)}`}
                      className="inline-flex h-9 items-center rounded-sm border border-line px-3 text-sm hover:bg-beige"
                    >
                      {c.name}
                    </Link>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            ) : null}
            {d.description ? (
              <p className="mt-6 whitespace-pre-line leading-relaxed text-charcoal">{d.description}</p>
            ) : null}
            <p className="mt-6 text-sm text-stone">
              Final price depends on the site, material and labour. We give a quotation after reviewing your
              requirements.
            </p>

            <div className="mt-8 flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:flex-wrap">
              <Button asChild size="lg">
                <Link href={`/custom-design?design=${encodeURIComponent(d.slug)}`}>Request This Design</Link>
              </Button>
              <WhatsAppLink settings={settings} kind="design" itemName={d.title} path={path} size="lg" />
            </div>
            <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              {settings.features.favourites ? <FavouriteButton slug={d.slug} title={d.title} variant="full" /> : null}
              <ShareButton title={d.title} url={`${settings.siteUrl}${path}`} />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Section>

      {related.length > 0 ? (
        <Section tone="beige">
          <SectionHeading title="Related designs" />
          <div className="mt-10 grid gap-8 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
            {related.map((r) => (
              <DesignCard key={r.id} design={r} showFavourite={settings.features.favourites} />
            ))}
          </div>
        </Section>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

===== src\app\(site)\projects\(list)\page.tsx =====
import Link from "next/link";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";
import { Section } from "@/components/layout/section";
import { ProjectCard } from "@/components/shared/cards";
import { WhatsAppLink } from "@/components/shared/contact-buttons";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/states/empty-state";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/states/error-state";
import { getBusinessSettings } from "@/lib/business-settings";
import { getProjects } from "@/lib/content";
import { pageMetadata } from "@/lib/seo";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export const metadata = pageMetadata({
  title: "Our Projects",
  description: "Completed POP and PVC interior projects by Shree Krishna Enterprises.",
  path: "/projects",
});

const chip = "inline-flex h-11 items-center rounded-sm border px-4 text-[0.95rem]";

export default async function ProjectsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ service?: string }>;
}) {
  const { service } = await searchParams;
  const [settings, projects] = await Promise.all([getBusinessSettings(), getProjects()]);

  // Filter options come from the projects themselves, so only used services appear.
  const services = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const p of projects.data) if (p.services) services.set(p.services.slug, p.services.title);

  const shown = service ? projects.data.filter((p) => p.services?.slug === service) : projects.data;

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Our Projects"
        description="Our completed work. Every project listed here was done by Shree Krishna Enterprises."
      />
      <Section>
        {projects.failed ? (
          <ErrorState />
        ) : projects.data.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            title="Projects will appear here soon"
            description="We are adding photos of our completed work. Message us and we can share examples on WhatsApp."
            action={<WhatsAppLink settings={settings} />}
          />
        ) : (
          <>
            {services.size > 1 ? (
              <nav aria-label="Filter by service" className="mb-10 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <Link
                  href="/projects"
                  aria-current={!service ? "true" : undefined}
                  className={cn(chip, !service ? "border-charcoal bg-charcoal text-warm-white" : "border-line hover:bg-beige")}
                >
                  All
                </Link>
                {[...services].map(([slug, title]) => (
                  <Link
                    key={slug}
                    href={`/projects?service=${encodeURIComponent(slug)}`}
                    aria-current={service === slug ? "true" : undefined}
                    className={cn(chip, service === slug ? "border-charcoal bg-charcoal text-warm-white" : "border-line hover:bg-beige")}
                  >
                    {title}
                  </Link>
                ))}
              </nav>
            ) : null}
            {shown.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title="No projects in this category yet" />
            ) : (
              <div className="grid gap-8 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
                {shown.map((p) => (
                  <ProjectCard key={p.id} project={p} />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </Section>
    </>
  );
}

===== src\app\(site)\projects\[slug]\page.tsx =====
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Section } from "@/components/layout/section";
import { BeforeAfterSlider } from "@/components/shared/before-after-slider";
import { ItemImage } from "@/components/shared/item-image";
import { SectionHeading } from "@/components/shared/section-heading";
import { CallLink, WhatsAppLink } from "@/components/shared/contact-buttons";
import { getBusinessSettings } from "@/lib/business-settings";
import { byOrder, getProject, projectCover } from "@/lib/content";
import { publicMediaUrl } from "@/lib/storage";
import { pageMetadata } from "@/lib/seo";
import { toEmbedUrl } from "@/lib/video";

export const revalidate = 60;

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const { data: project } = await getProject(slug);
  if (!project) return { title: "Project not found" };
  return pageMetadata({
    title: project.title,
    description: project.description?.slice(0, 160) ?? `Completed project: ${project.title}.`,
    path: `/projects/${project.slug}`,
    image: publicMediaUrl(projectCover(project)?.path),
  });
}

export default async function ProjectDetailPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const [settings, result] = await Promise.all([getBusinessSettings(), getProject(slug)]);
  if (!result.data) notFound();
  const p = result.data;

  const images = byOrder(p.project_images ?? []);
  const gallery = images.filter((i) => i.kind === "gallery");
  const befores = images.filter((i) => i.kind === "before");
  const afters = images.filter((i) => i.kind === "after");
  const pairs = settings.features.before_after
    ? befores.slice(0, afters.length).map((b, i) => ({ before: b, after: afters[i] }))
    : [];
  const embed = settings.features.video_gallery ? toEmbedUrl(p.video_url) : null;

  const date = p.completed_on
    ? new Date(p.completed_on).toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { month: "long", year: "numeric" })
    : null;
  const meta = [p.services?.title, p.location, date].filter(Boolean).join(" Â· ");

  return (
    <>
      <Section>
        <Link href="/projects" className="text-stone underline hover:text-charcoal">
          All projects
        </Link>
        <p className="mt-6 text-sm font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-gold-deep">Our completed work</p>
        <h1 className="mt-2 text-4xl text-charcoal sm:text-5xl">{p.title}</h1>
        {meta ? <p className="mt-3 text-stone">{meta}</p> : null}
        {p.description ? (
          <p className="mt-6 max-w-2xl whitespace-pre-line text-lg leading-relaxed text-charcoal">{p.description}</p>
        ) : null}
        <div className="mt-8 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
          <Button asChild size="lg">
            <Link href="/quote">Get Free Quote</Link>
          </Button>
          <WhatsAppLink settings={settings} kind="project" itemName={p.title} path={`/projects/${p.slug}`} size="lg" />
          <CallLink settings={settings} size="lg" />
        </div>
      </Section>

      {pairs.length > 0 ? (
        <Section tone="beige">
          <SectionHeading title="Before and after" description="Drag the handle or use the arrow keys." />
          <div className="mt-10 grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-2">
            {pairs.map(({ before, after }) => {
              const b = publicMediaUrl(before.storage_path);
              const a = publicMediaUrl(after.storage_path);
              return b && a ? (
                <BeforeAfterSlider
                  key={before.id}
                  beforeSrc={b}
                  afterSrc={a}
                  beforeAlt={before.alt_text || `${p.title} before`}
                  afterAlt={after.alt_text || `${p.title} after`}
                />
              ) : null;
            })}
          </div>
        </Section>
      ) : null}

      {gallery.length > 0 ? (
        <Section>
          <SectionHeading title="Photos" />
          <ul className="mt-10 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
            {gallery.map((img, i) => (
              <li key={img.id} className={i === 0 && gallery.length > 2 ? "sm:col-span-2 lg:col-span-2" : ""}>
                <ItemImage
                  path={img.storage_path}
                  alt={img.alt_text || `${p.title} photo ${i + 1}`}
                  className="aspect-[4/3]"
                  priority={i === 0}
                />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </Section>
      ) : null}

      {embed ? (
        <Section tone="beige">
          <SectionHeading title="Video" />
          <div className="mt-8 aspect-video max-w-3xl overflow-hidden bg-charcoal">
            <iframe
              src={embed}
              title={`${p.title} video`}
              loading="lazy"
              allow="accelerometer; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture"
              allowFullScreen
              referrerPolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
              className="h-full w-full"
            />
          </div>
        </Section>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/states/empty-state";
import { getBusinessSettings } from "@/lib/business-settings";
import { buildEnquiryMessage, buildWhatsAppLink } from "@/lib/whatsapp";
import { createPublicClient, getPublicMediaUrl } from "@/lib/supabase/public";

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Interior Services | POP False Ceilings & PVC Wall Panels",
  description:
    "Explore our professional false ceiling services: POP ceilings, cove lighting channels, decorative wall mouldings, and moisture-proof PVC panels.",
};

export const revalidate = 60;

type Service = {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  short_description: string | null;
  description: string | null;
  cover_image_path: string | null;
  sort_order: number;
};

export default async function ServicesPage() {
  const settings = await getBusinessSettings();
  const supabase = createPublicClient();

  let services: Service[] = [];

  if (supabase) {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("services")
        .select("id, slug, title, short_description, description, cover_image_path, sort_order")
        .eq("is_published", true)
        .order("sort_order", { ascending: true })
        .order("title", { ascending: true });

      if (!error && data) {
        services = data;
      }
    } catch {
      // Graceful fallback if database table not yet populated
    }
  }

  const generalWhatsAppHref = buildWhatsAppLink({
    whatsappNumber: settings.whatsappNumber,
    message: buildEnquiryMessage({ kind: "general" }),
  });

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Our Services &amp; Specialties"
        description="Comprehensive Plaster of Paris (POP) false ceiling designs, architectural mouldings, and modern PVC wall panel installations."
      />

      {/* 1. SERVICES CATALOG */}
      <Section>
        {services.length > 0 ? (
          <div className="grid gap-8 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
            {services.map((service) => {
              const imageUrl = getPublicMediaUrl(service.cover_image_path);
              const serviceUrl = `${settings.siteUrl}/services/${service.slug}`;
              const whatsappHref = buildWhatsAppLink({
                whatsappNumber: settings.whatsappNumber,
                message: buildEnquiryMessage({
                  kind: "service",
                  itemName: service.title,
                  url: serviceUrl,
                }),
              });

              return (
                <Card key={service.id} className="flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden transition-shadow hover:shadow-md">
                  <div>
                    {imageUrl ? (
                      <div className="aspect-[16/9] w-full overflow-hidden bg-beige">
                        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                        <img
                          src={imageUrl}
                          alt={service.title}
                          className="h-full w-full object-cover transition-transform duration-300 hover:scale-105"
                          loading="lazy"
                        />
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="flex aspect-[16/9] w-full items-center justify-center bg-beige/50 text-stone">
                        <Layers className="size-10 text-stone/40" aria-hidden="true" />
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <CardHeader>
                      <CardTitle className="text-2xl">
                        <Link href={`/services/${service.slug}`} className="hover:text-gold-deep">
                          {service.title}
                        </Link>
                      </CardTitle>
                      {service.short_description ? (
                        <CardDescription className="mt-2.5 line-clamp-3 text-base">
                          {service.short_description}
                        </CardDescription>
                      ) : null}
                    </CardHeader>
                  </div>

                  <CardContent className="pt-0">
                    <div className="space-y-3 border-t border-line/80 pt-4">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                        <Button asChild size="sm" variant="default" className="flex-1">
                          <Link href={`/services/${service.slug}`}>
                            <span>View details</span>
                            <ArrowRight className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                          </Link>
                        </Button>
                        <Button asChild size="sm" variant="whatsapp">
                          <a href={whatsappHref} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                            <MessageCircle className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                            <span>Enquire</span>
                          </a>
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <EmptyState
            title="Service listings being updated"
            description="Our service catalog is currently being organized. We provide all forms of POP false ceiling work, decorative mouldings, and PVC paneling."
            action={
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                <Button asChild>
                  <Link href="/quote">Request Free Quote</Link>
                </Button>
                <Button asChild variant="whatsapp">
                  <a href={generalWhatsAppHref} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                    <MessageCircle className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                    Enquire on WhatsApp
                  </a>
                </Button>
              </div>
            }
          />
        )}
      </Section>

      {/* 2. MATERIAL COMPARISON: POP VS PVC */}
      <Section tone="beige">
        <div className="max-w-2xl">
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gold-deep">Material Guide</span>
          <h2 className="mt-2 text-3xl text-charcoal sm:text-4xl">POP vs. PVC: Choosing What Fits Your Space</h2>
          <p className="mt-3 text-stone">
            Both Plaster of Paris and PVC offer distinctive benefits depending on room moisture, lighting design, and maintenance preferences.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-10 grid gap-8 md:grid-cols-2">
          {/* POP Card */}
          <Card className="border-line bg-warm-white p-6 sm:p-8">

===== src\app\(site)\services\[slug]\page.tsx =====
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Section } from "@/components/layout/section";
import { ItemImage } from "@/components/shared/item-image";
import { SectionHeading } from "@/components/shared/section-heading";
import { DesignCard, ProjectCard } from "@/components/shared/cards";
import { CallLink, WhatsAppLink } from "@/components/shared/contact-buttons";
import { getBusinessSettings } from "@/lib/business-settings";
import { getDesigns, getProjects, getService } from "@/lib/content";
import { publicMediaUrl } from "@/lib/storage";
import { pageMetadata } from "@/lib/seo";

export const revalidate = 60;

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const { data: service } = await getService(slug);
  if (!service) return { title: "Service not found" };
  return pageMetadata({
    title: service.title,
    description: service.short_description ?? `${service.title} by Shree Krishna Enterprises.`,
    path: `/services/${service.slug}`,
    image: publicMediaUrl(service.cover_image_path),
  });
}

export default async function ServiceDetailPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const [settings, service] = await Promise.all([getBusinessSettings(), getService(slug)]);
  if (!service.data) notFound();
  const s = service.data;

  const [designs, projects] = await Promise.all([getDesigns(), getProjects()]);
  const relatedDesigns = designs.data.filter((d) => d.service_id === s.id).slice(0, 3);
  const relatedProjects = projects.data.filter((p) => p.service_id === s.id).slice(0, 3);

  return (
    <>
      <Section>
        <Link href="/services" className="text-stone underline hover:text-charcoal">
          All services
        </Link>
        <div className="mt-6 grid gap-10 lg:grid-cols-2">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-4xl text-charcoal sm:text-5xl">{s.title}</h1>
            {s.short_description ? <p className="mt-4 text-lg text-stone">{s.short_description}</p> : null}
            {s.description ? (
              <p className="mt-6 whitespace-pre-line leading-relaxed text-charcoal">{s.description}</p>
            ) : null}
            <div className="mt-8 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              <Button asChild size="lg">
                <Link href="/quote">Get Free Quote</Link>
              </Button>
              <WhatsAppLink
                settings={settings}
                kind="service"
                itemName={s.title}
                path={`/services/${s.slug}`}
                size="lg"
              />
              <CallLink settings={settings} size="lg" />
            </div>
          </div>
          {s.cover_image_path ? (
            <ItemImage path={s.cover_image_path} alt={s.title} className="aspect-[4/3]" priority />
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </Section>

      {relatedDesigns.length > 0 ? (
        <Section tone="beige">
          <SectionHeading title={`${s.title} designs`} />
          <div className="mt-10 grid gap-8 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
            {relatedDesigns.map((d) => (
              <DesignCard key={d.id} design={d} showFavourite={settings.features.favourites} />
            ))}
          </div>
        </Section>
      ) : null}

      {relatedProjects.length > 0 ? (
        <Section>
          <SectionHeading eyebrow="Our work" title={`${s.title} projects`} />
          <div className="mt-10 grid gap-8 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
            {relatedProjects.map((p) => (
              <ProjectCard key={p.id} project={p} />
            ))}
          </div>
        </Section>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}
