===== src\app\admin\actions.ts =====
"use server";

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { z } from "zod";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { getSupabaseEnv, isSupabaseConfigured } from "@/lib/supabase/env";
import { getAdminSession } from "@/lib/auth";
import { logActivity } from "@/lib/activity-log";

export type LoginState = { error?: string } | null;

const loginSchema = z.object({
  email: z.string().trim().email("Enter a valid email address.").max(254),
  password: z.string().min(1, "Enter your password.").max(200),
});

export async function signIn(_prev: LoginState, formData: FormData): Promise<LoginState> {
  if (!isSupabaseConfigured()) {
    return { error: "Supabase is not set up yet. Add the Supabase keys to .env.local and restart." };
  }

  const parsed = loginSchema.safeParse({
    email: formData.get("email"),
    password: formData.get("password"),
  });
  if (!parsed.success) return { error: parsed.error.issues[0].message };

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword(parsed.data);

  // Extra details are shown only while developing on your own computer, never on the live site.
  const dev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production";
  let host = "";
  try {
    host = new URL(getSupabaseEnv()?.url ?? "").hostname;
  } catch {}

  if (error) {
    const detail = dev ? ` [${error.code ?? error.name}: ${error.message}. Connected to: ${host}]` : "";

    if (error.name === "AuthRetryableFetchError") {
      return { error: "Could not reach Supabase. Check NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and your internet connection." + detail };
    }
    if (error.code === "email_not_confirmed") {
      return {
        error:
          "This email is not confirmed yet. In Supabase open Authentication, Users and confirm it, or delete the user and create it again with Auto Confirm User ticked.",
      };
    }
    if (error.code === "invalid_api_key" || /api key/i.test(error.message)) {
      return { error: "The Supabase key in .env.local is wrong. Use the publishable (anon) key, not the secret key." + detail };
    }
    // Wrong email and wrong password give the same message, so accounts cannot be guessed.
    if (error.code === "invalid_credentials") {
      return { error: "Email or password is incorrect." + detail };
    }
    return { error: "Sign in failed." + detail };
  }

  const session = await getAdminSession();
  if (!session) {
    let detail = "";
    if (dev) {
      const { data: u } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
      const { data: p, error: pe } = await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .select("role, is_active")
        .eq("id", u.user?.id ?? "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000")
        .maybeSingle();
      const profileText = p ? `role=${p.role}, active=${p.is_active}` : "NOT FOUND";
      detail =
        ` [logged in as: ${u.user?.email ?? "nobody"}; profile: ${profileText}` +
        `${pe ? `; db error: ${pe.message}` : ""}; project: ${host}]`;
    }
    await supabase.auth.signOut();
    return { error: "This account does not have admin access." + detail };
  }

  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "login" });
  redirect("/admin");
}

export async function signOut() {
  if (isSupabaseConfigured()) {
    const supabase = await createClient();
    await supabase.auth.signOut();
  }
  redirect("/admin/login");
}

import Link from "next/link";
import {

import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { signOut } from "../actions";

const adminNav = [
  { href: "/admin", label: "Dashboard", icon: LayoutDashboard },
  { href: "/admin/enquiries", label: "Enquiries", icon: Inbox },
  { href: "/admin/applications", label: "Applications", icon: Users },
  { href: "/admin/reviews", label: "Reviews", icon: Star },
  { href: "/admin/services", label: "Services", icon: Briefcase },
  { href: "/admin/projects", label: "Projects", icon: ImageIcon },
  { href: "/admin/designs", label: "Designs", icon: ImageIcon },
  { href: "/admin/faqs", label: "FAQs", icon: MessageSquare },
  { href: "/admin/service-areas", label: "Service areas", icon: MapPin },
  { href: "/admin/settings", label: "Business settings", icon: Settings },
];

export default async function ProtectedAdminLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  // Server-side check on every request. Hiding links in the UI is not security.
  const session = await requireAdmin();

  // Small "needs attention" numbers next to the menu items. If a count fails, no number is shown.
  const sb = await createClient();
  const head = { count: "exact" as const, head: true };
  const [newEnquiries, newApplications, pendingReviews] = await Promise.all([
    sb.from("enquiries").select("*", head).eq("status", "new"),
    sb.from("worker_applications").select("*", head).eq("status", "new"),
    sb.from("reviews").select("*", head).eq("status", "pending"),
  ]);
  const badges: Record<string, number | null> = {
    "/admin/enquiries": newEnquiries.count,
    "/admin/applications": newApplications.count,
    "/admin/reviews": pendingReviews.count,
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col md:flex-row">
      <aside className="border-b border-line bg-charcoal text-warm-white md:w-64 md:border-b-0 md:border-r">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-4 md:block">
          <p className="font-serif text-xl">Admin</p>
          <p className="hidden text-sm text-warm-white/60 md:mt-1 md:block">{session.email}</p>
        </div>
        <nav aria-label="Admin" className="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto px-3 pb-3 md:flex-col md:pb-0">
          {adminNav.map(({ href, label, icon: Icon }) => {
            const count = badges[href];
            return (
              <Link
                key={href}
                href={href}
                className="flex items-center gap-3 whitespace-nowrap rounded-sm px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-warm-white/85 hover:bg-white/10"
              >
                <Icon className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                {label}
                {count ? (
                  <span
                    className="ml-auto rounded-full bg-gold px-2 text-xs font-medium text-charcoal"
                    aria-label={`${count} waiting`}
                  >
                    {count}
                  </span>
                ) : null}
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </nav>
        <form action={signOut} className="hidden px-3 py-4 md:block">
          <Button type="submit" variant="outline" size="sm" className="w-full border-warm-white/40 text-warm-white hover:bg-warm-white hover:text-charcoal">
            Sign out
          </Button>
        </form>
      </aside>
      <div className="flex-1 bg-warm-white">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl px-5 py-8 sm:px-8">{children}</div>
        <form action={signOut} className="px-5 pb-8 md:hidden">
          <Button type="submit" variant="outline" size="sm">Sign out</Button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\app\admin\(protected)\page.tsx =====
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";

export const metadata = { title: "Dashboard" };

type Notification = { id: string; title: string; body: string | null; is_read: boolean; created_at: string };

export default async function DashboardPage() {
  await requireAdmin();
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const head = { count: "exact" as const, head: true };

  const [enquiries, newEnquiries, quotations, applications, pendingReviews, projects, publishedProjects, notifications] =
    await Promise.all([
      supabase.from("enquiries").select("*", head),
      supabase.from("enquiries").select("*", head).eq("status", "new"),
      supabase.from("enquiries").select("*", head).eq("kind", "quotation"),
      supabase.from("worker_applications").select("*", head),
      supabase.from("reviews").select("*", head).eq("status", "pending"),
      supabase.from("projects").select("*", head),
      supabase.from("projects").select("*", head).eq("is_published", true),
      supabase
        .from("notifications")
        .select("id, title, body, is_read, created_at")
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
        .limit(6),
    ]);

  const failed = [enquiries, newEnquiries, quotations, applications, pendingReviews, projects, publishedProjects].some(
    (r) => r.error,
  );

  const stats = [
    { label: "Total enquiries", value: enquiries.count },
    { label: "New enquiries", value: newEnquiries.count },
    { label: "Quotation requests", value: quotations.count },
    { label: "Worker applications", value: applications.count },
    { label: "Reviews waiting for approval", value: pendingReviews.count },
    { label: "Projects (published / total)", value: `${publishedProjects.count ?? 0} / ${projects.count ?? 0}` },
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      <h1 className="text-3xl text-charcoal">Dashboard</h1>

      {failed ? (
        <p role="alert" className="mt-6 rounded-sm border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-red-800">
          The database tables could not be read. Run <code>supabase/setup.sql</code> in the Supabase SQL editor,
          then reload this page.
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <dl className="mt-8 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {stats.map((s) => (
          <div key={s.label} className="rounded-sm border border-line bg-beige/40 p-5">
            <dt className="text-sm text-stone">{s.label}</dt>
            <dd className="mt-2 font-serif text-4xl text-charcoal">{s.value ?? 0}</dd>
          </div>
        ))}
      </dl>

      <h2 className="mt-12 text-2xl text-charcoal">Latest notifications</h2>
      {(notifications.data as Notification[] | null)?.length ? (
        <ul className="mt-4 divide-y divide-line rounded-sm border border-line">
          {(notifications.data as Notification[]).map((n) => (
            <li key={n.id} className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-3">
              <div>
                <p className={n.is_read ? "text-stone" : "font-medium text-charcoal"}>{n.title}</p>
                {n.body ? <p className="text-sm text-stone">{n.body}</p> : null}
              </div>
              <time dateTime={n.created_at} className="shrink-0 text-sm text-stone">
                {new Date(n.created_at).toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { day: "numeric", month: "short" })}
              </time>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : (
        <p className="mt-4 text-stone">Nothing yet. New enquiries, reviews and applications will show up here.</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\app\admin\(protected)\applications\actions.ts =====
"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { z } from "zod";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { logActivity } from "@/lib/activity-log";
import { cleanText } from "@/lib/sanitize";
import { APPLICATION_STATUSES } from "@/lib/admin-status";
import { removePrivateFiles } from "@/lib/private-files";
import type { FormState } from "@/lib/form-state";

const schema = z.object({
  status: z.enum(APPLICATION_STATUSES, "Choose a status."),
  admin_notes: z.string().max(4000),
});

export async function updateApplication(id: string, _prev: FormState, formData: FormData): Promise<FormState> {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const parsed = schema.safeParse({
    status: formData.get("status"),
    admin_notes: cleanText(formData.get("admin_notes"), 4000),
  });
  if (!parsed.success) {
    const fieldErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const i of parsed.error.issues) fieldErrors[String(i.path[0])] ??= i.message;
    return { ok: false, message: "Please fix the highlighted fields.", fieldErrors };
  }

  const sb = await createClient();
  const { error } = await sb
    .from("worker_applications")
    .update({ status: parsed.data.status, admin_notes: parsed.data.admin_notes || null })
    .eq("id", id);
  if (error) return { ok: false, message: "Could not save. Try again." };

  await logActivity({
    adminId: session.userId,
    action: "update_application",
    entityType: "worker_applications",
    entityId: id,
    details: { status: parsed.data.status },
  });
  revalidatePath("/admin/applications");
  revalidatePath(`/admin/applications/${id}`);
  revalidatePath("/admin");
  return { ok: true, message: "Saved." };
}

export async function deleteApplication(id: string) {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const sb = await createClient();
  const { data: images } = await sb
    .from("worker_application_images")
    .select("storage_path")
    .eq("application_id", id);
  const { error } = await sb.from("worker_applications").delete().eq("id", id);
  if (error) return;
  await removePrivateFiles((images ?? []).map((i: { storage_path: string }) => i.storage_path));
  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "delete_application", entityType: "worker_applications", entityId: id });
  revalidatePath("/admin/applications");
  revalidatePath("/admin");
  redirect("/admin/applications");
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";

import { APPLICATION_STATUSES, APPLICATION_STATUS_LABELS, applicationTone } from "@/lib/admin-status";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/admin-helpers";

export const metadata = { title: "Worker applications" };

type Row = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  phone: string;
  role_title: string;
  location: string | null;
  experience_years: number | null;
  status: string;
  created_at: string;
};

export default async function AdminApplicationsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ status?: string }>;
}) {
  await requireAdmin();
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const status = APPLICATION_STATUSES.find((s) => s === sp.status);

  const sb = await createClient();
  let query = sb
    .from("worker_applications")
    .select("id, name, phone, role_title, location, experience_years, status, created_at")
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(200);
  if (status) query = query.eq("status", status);
  const { data, error } = await query;
  const rows = (data ?? []) as Row[];

  const chips: Chip[] = [
    { label: "All", href: "/admin/applications", active: !status },
    ...APPLICATION_STATUSES.map((s) => ({
      label: APPLICATION_STATUS_LABELS[s],
      href: `/admin/applications?status=${s}`,
      active: status === s,
    })),
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      <h1 className="text-3xl text-charcoal">Worker applications</h1>
      <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-stone">People who applied from the Join Our Team page. Newest first.</p>

      <div className="mt-6">
        <FilterChips label="Filter by status" items={chips} />
      </div>

      <div className="mt-8">
        {error ? (
          <p role="alert" className="rounded-sm border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-red-800">
            Could not load applications.
          </p>
        ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            title={status ? "No applications with this status" : "No applications yet"}
            description={status ? "Try another filter." : "Applications from the Join Our Team page will appear here."}
          />
        ) : (
          <ul className="divide-y divide-line rounded-sm border border-line">
            {rows.map((a) => (
              <li key={a.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-3">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <Link href={`/admin/applications/${a.id}`} className="font-medium text-charcoal hover:text-gold-deep">
                    {a.name}
                  </Link>
                  <p className="text-sm text-stone">
                    {a.role_title}
                    {a.location ? ` Â· ${a.location}` : ""}
                    {a.experience_years !== null ? ` Â· ${Number(a.experience_years)} yrs` : ""} Â·{" "}
                    {formatDate(a.created_at)}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <Badge tone={applicationTone(a.status)}>{APPLICATION_STATUS_LABELS[a.status] ?? a.status}</Badge>

import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { signedUrlsFor } from "@/lib/private-files";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/admin/data-table";
import { DeleteButton } from "@/components/admin/delete-button";
import { DetailList } from "@/components/admin/detail-list";
import { PhotoGrid } from "@/components/admin/photo-grid";
import { StatusNotesForm } from "@/components/admin/status-notes-form";
import { APPLICATION_STATUSES, APPLICATION_STATUS_LABELS, applicationTone, optionsFrom } from "@/lib/admin-status";
import { formatDateTime, telLink, whatsappLink } from "@/lib/admin-helpers";
import { deleteApplication, updateApplication } from "../actions";

export const metadata = { title: "Worker application" };

export default async function ApplicationDetailPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  await requireAdmin();
  const { id } = await params;
  const sb = await createClient();

  const { data: a } = await sb.from("worker_applications").select("*").eq("id", id).maybeSingle();
  if (!a) notFound();

  const { data: imageRows } = await sb
    .from("worker_application_images")
    .select("id, storage_path")
    .eq("application_id", id)
    .order("created_at");
  const images = (imageRows ?? []) as { id: string; storage_path: string }[];
  const urls = await signedUrlsFor(images.map((i) => i.storage_path));
  const photos = images.flatMap((i) => {
    const url = urls.get(i.storage_path);
    return url ? [{ id: i.id, url }] : [];
  });

  const update = updateApplication.bind(null, id);
  const del = deleteApplication.bind(null, id);

  return (
    <div>
      <Link href="/admin/applications" className="text-sm text-stone hover:text-charcoal">
        â† All applications
      </Link>

      <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl text-charcoal">{a.name}</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-stone">
            <span>{a.role_title}</span>
            <Badge tone={applicationTone(a.status)}>{APPLICATION_STATUS_LABELS[a.status] ?? a.status}</Badge>
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Button asChild variant="outline">
            <a href={telLink(a.phone)}>Call</a>
          </Button>
          <Button asChild variant="whatsapp">
            <a href={whatsappLink(a.phone)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
              WhatsApp
            </a>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <section className="mt-8" aria-labelledby="details">
        <h2 id="details" className="mb-3 text-2xl text-charcoal">
          Details
        </h2>
        <DetailList
          items={[
            { label: "Applied", value: formatDateTime(a.created_at) },
            { label: "Phone", value: a.phone },
            { label: "Role", value: a.role_title },
            { label: "Location", value: a.location },
            {
              label: "Experience",
              value: a.experience_years !== null ? `${Number(a.experience_years)} years` : null,
            },
            { label: "Skills", value: a.skills },
            { label: "Expected salary", value: a.expected_salary },
            { label: "Availability", value: a.availability },
            { label: "Introduction", value: a.introduction },
          ]}
        />
        {photos.length > 0 ? (
          <div className="mt-6">
            <h3 className="text-lg text-charcoal">Work photos</h3>
            <PhotoGrid photos={photos} />
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </section>

      <section className="mt-10" aria-labelledby="manage">
        <h2 id="manage" className="mb-3 text-2xl text-charcoal">
          Status and notes
        </h2>
        <StatusNotesForm
          statuses={optionsFrom(APPLICATION_STATUSES, APPLICATION_STATUS_LABELS)}
          values={{ status: a.status, admin_notes: a.admin_notes ?? "", follow_up_on: "" }}
          action={update}
        />
      </section>

      <section className="mt-12 border-t border-line pt-6">
        <h2 className="text-lg text-charcoal">Delete this application</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 max-w-xl text-sm text-stone">Removes the application and the uploaded photos.</p>
        <form action={del} className="mt-3">
          <DeleteButton confirm={`Delete the application from ${a.name}? This cannot be undone.`} />
        </form>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\app\admin\(protected)\designs\actions.ts =====
"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { z } from "zod";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { logActivity } from "@/lib/activity-log";
import { cleanText } from "@/lib/sanitize";
import { slugify } from "@/lib/slug";
import { deletePublicImage, uploadPublicImage } from "@/lib/upload";

export type FormState = { ok?: boolean; message?: string; fieldErrors?: Record<string, string> } | null;

const schema = z.object({
  title: z.string().min(2, "Enter a title.").max(120),
  description: z.string().max(4000).optional().default(""),
  service_id: z.string().optional().default(""),
  is_published: z.boolean(),
  is_featured: z.boolean(),
});

function readForm(formData: FormData) {
  return {
    title: cleanText(formData.get("title"), 120),
    description: cleanText(formData.get("description"), 4000),
    service_id: String(formData.get("service_id") ?? "").trim(),
    is_published: formData.get("is_published") === "on",
    is_featured: formData.get("is_featured") === "on",
    category_ids: formData.getAll("category_ids").map(String),
  };
}

function toPatch(data: z.infer<typeof schema>) {
  return {
    title: data.title,
    description: data.description || null,
    service_id: data.service_id || null,
    is_published: data.is_published,
    is_featured: data.is_featured,
  };
}

async function uniqueSlug(sb: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createClient>>, base: string, excludeId?: string) {
  let slug = slugify(base) || "design";
  let n = 1;
  for (;;) {
    let q = sb.from("designs").select("id").eq("slug", slug);
    if (excludeId) q = q.neq("id", excludeId);
    const { data } = await q.maybeSingle();
    if (!data) return slug;
    n += 1;
    slug = `${slugify(base)}-${n}`;
  }
}

async function syncCategories(sb: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createClient>>, designId: string, categoryIds: string[]) {
  await sb.from("design_category_links").delete().eq("design_id", designId);
  const rows = categoryIds.slice(0, 20).map((category_id) => ({ design_id: designId, category_id }));
  if (rows.length > 0) await sb.from("design_category_links").insert(rows);
}

export async function createDesign(_prev: FormState, formData: FormData): Promise<FormState> {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const raw = readForm(formData);
  const parsed = schema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    const fieldErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const i of parsed.error.issues) fieldErrors[String(i.path[0])] ??= i.message;
    return { ok: false, message: "Please fix the highlighted fields.", fieldErrors };
  }

  const sb = await createClient();
  const slug = await uniqueSlug(sb, parsed.data.title);

  let cover_image_path: string | null = null;
  const image = formData.get("cover_image") as File | null;
  if (image && image.size > 0) {
    const result = await uploadPublicImage(image, "designs");
    if ("error" in result) return { ok: false, message: result.error };
    cover_image_path = result.path;
  }

  const { data, error } = await sb
    .from("designs")
    .insert({ ...toPatch(parsed.data), slug, cover_image_path })
    .select("id")
    .single();
  if (error || !data) return { ok: false, message: "Could not save the design." };

  await syncCategories(sb, data.id, raw.category_ids);
  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "create_design", entityType: "designs", entityId: data.id });
  revalidatePath("/designs");
  revalidatePath("/");
  redirect(`/admin/designs/${data.id}`);
}

export async function updateDesign(id: string, _prev: FormState, formData: FormData): Promise<FormState> {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const raw = readForm(formData);
  const parsed = schema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    const fieldErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const i of parsed.error.issues) fieldErrors[String(i.path[0])] ??= i.message;
    return { ok: false, message: "Please fix the highlighted fields.", fieldErrors };
  }

  const sb = await createClient();
  const { data: existing } = await sb.from("designs").select("title, slug, cover_image_path").eq("id", id).maybeSingle();
  if (!existing) return { ok: false, message: "This design no longer exists." };

  const patch: Record<string, unknown> = toPatch(parsed.data);
  if (parsed.data.title !== existing.title) patch.slug = await uniqueSlug(sb, parsed.data.title, id);

  const image = formData.get("cover_image") as File | null;
  const removeCover = formData.get("remove_cover_image") === "on";
  if (image && image.size > 0) {
    const result = await uploadPublicImage(image, "designs");
    if ("error" in result) return { ok: false, message: result.error };
    patch.cover_image_path = result.path;
    await deletePublicImage(existing.cover_image_path);
  } else if (removeCover) {
    patch.cover_image_path = null;
    await deletePublicImage(existing.cover_image_path);
  }

  const { error } = await sb.from("designs").update(patch).eq("id", id);
  if (error) return { ok: false, message: "Could not save the design." };

  await syncCategories(sb, id, raw.category_ids);
  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "update_design", entityType: "designs", entityId: id });
  revalidatePath("/designs");
  revalidatePath(`/designs/${(patch.slug as string) ?? existing.slug}`);
  revalidatePath("/");
  return { ok: true, message: "Saved." };
}

export async function deleteDesign(id: string) {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const sb = await createClient();
  const { data: design } = await sb.from("designs").select("cover_image_path").eq("id", id).maybeSingle();
  const { data: images } = await sb.from("design_images").select("storage_path").eq("design_id", id);
  const { error } = await sb.from("designs").delete().eq("id", id);
  if (error) return;
  await deletePublicImage(design?.cover_image_path);
  await Promise.all((images ?? []).map((i) => deletePublicImage(i.storage_path)));
  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "delete_design", entityType: "designs", entityId: id });
  revalidatePath("/designs");
  revalidatePath("/");
  redirect("/admin/designs");
}

export async function addDesignImage(designId: string, _prev: FormState, formData: FormData): Promise<FormState> {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const file = formData.get("image") as File | null;
  if (!file || file.size === 0) return { ok: false, message: "Choose a photo to upload." };

  const result = await uploadPublicImage(file, `designs/${designId}`);
  if ("error" in result) return { ok: false, message: result.error };

  const sb = await createClient();
  const { count } = await sb.from("design_images").select("*", { count: "exact", head: true }).eq("design_id", designId);
  const { error } = await sb
    .from("design_images")
    .insert({ design_id: designId, storage_path: result.path, sort_order: count ?? 0 });
  if (error) {
    await deletePublicImage(result.path);
    return { ok: false, message: "Could not save the photo." };
  }

  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "add_design_image", entityType: "designs", entityId: designId });
  revalidatePath(`/admin/designs/${designId}`);
  revalidatePath("/designs");
  return { ok: true, message: "Photo added." };
}

export async function deleteDesignImage(designId: string, imageId: string) {
  await requireAdmin();
  const sb = await createClient();
  const { data } = await sb.from("design_images").select("storage_path").eq("id", imageId).maybeSingle();
  const { error } = await sb.from("design_images").delete().eq("id", imageId);
  if (error) return;
  await deletePublicImage(data?.storage_path);
  revalidatePath(`/admin/designs/${designId}`);
  revalidatePath("/designs");
}

"use client";

import { useActionState } from "react";
import Image from "next/image";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Field, Input, Textarea } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Checkbox, Select } from "@/components/ui/select";
import type { FormState } from "./actions";
import type { Category } from "@/lib/types";

export type DesignFormValues = {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  service_id: string;
  is_published: boolean;
  is_featured: boolean;
  category_ids: string[];
  cover_image_url: string | null;
};

const KIND_LABEL: Record<string, string> = { service: "Material", room: "Room", type: "Type", style: "Style", other: "Other" };

export function DesignForm({
  values,
  services,
  categories,
  action,
  submitLabel,
}: {
  values: DesignFormValues;
  services: { id: string; title: string }[];
  categories: Category[];
  action: (prev: FormState, formData: FormData) => Promise<FormState>;
  submitLabel: string;
}) {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState<FormState, FormData>(action, null);
  const err = state?.fieldErrors ?? {};

  const byKind = new Map<string, Category[]>();
  for (const c of categories) byKind.set(c.kind, [...(byKind.get(c.kind) ?? []), c]);

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="max-w-2xl space-y-6" noValidate>
      <Field label="Title" htmlFor="title" error={err.title}>
        <Input id="title" name="title" defaultValue={values.title} required maxLength={120} />
      </Field>
      <Field label="Related service" htmlFor="service_id">
        <Select id="service_id" name="service_id" defaultValue={values.service_id}>
          <option value="">No specific service</option>
          {services.map((s) => (
            <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.title}</option>
          ))}
        </Select>
      </Field>
      <Field label="Description" htmlFor="description" error={err.description}>
        <Textarea id="description" name="description" defaultValue={values.description} rows={5} maxLength={4000} />
      </Field>

      <fieldset>
        <legend className="text-sm font-medium text-charcoal">Categories</legend>
        <div className="mt-2 space-y-3">
          {[...byKind.entries()].map(([kind, group]) => (
            <div key={kind} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <span className="w-20 text-sm text-stone">{KIND_LABEL[kind] ?? kind}</span>
              {group.map((c) => (
                <label key={c.id} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-charcoal">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    name="category_ids"
                    value={c.id}
                    defaultChecked={values.category_ids.includes(c.id)}
                    className="size-4 rounded-sm border-line accent-gold"
                  />
                  {c.name}
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </fieldset>

      <div>
        <span className="block text-sm font-medium text-charcoal">Cover photo</span>
        {values.cover_image_url ? (
          <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-4">
            <Image src={values.cover_image_url} alt="" width={120} height={90} className="rounded-sm object-cover" />
            <Checkbox id="remove_cover_image" name="remove_cover_image" label="Remove current photo" />
          </div>
        ) : null}
        <input
          type="file"
          name="cover_image"
          accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp,image/avif"
          className="mt-2 block w-full text-sm text-stone file:mr-4 file:h-11 file:rounded-sm file:border-0 file:bg-charcoal file:px-4 file:text-warm-white"
        />
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-6">
        <Checkbox id="is_published" name="is_published" label="Published" defaultChecked={values.is_published} />
        <Checkbox id="is_featured" name="is_featured" label="Featured on home page" defaultChecked={values.is_featured} />
      </div>

      {state?.message ? (
        <p
          role={state.ok ? "status" : "alert"}
          className={state.ok ? "rounded-sm border border-green-200 bg-green-50 px-3 py-2 text-green-900" : "rounded-sm border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-red-800"}
        >
          {state.message}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <Button type="submit" size="lg" disabled={pending}>
        {pending ? "Saving" : submitLabel}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

===== src\app\admin\(protected)\enquiries\actions.ts =====
"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { z } from "zod";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { logActivity } from "@/lib/activity-log";
import { cleanText } from "@/lib/sanitize";
import { ENQUIRY_STATUSES } from "@/lib/admin-status";
import { removePrivateFiles } from "@/lib/private-files";
import type { FormState } from "@/lib/form-state";

const schema = z.object({
  status: z.enum(ENQUIRY_STATUSES, "Choose a status."),
  admin_notes: z.string().max(4000),
  follow_up_on: z.union([z.literal(""), z.string().regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/, "Enter a valid date.")]),
});

export async function updateEnquiry(id: string, _prev: FormState, formData: FormData): Promise<FormState> {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const parsed = schema.safeParse({
    status: formData.get("status"),
    admin_notes: cleanText(formData.get("admin_notes"), 4000),
    follow_up_on: cleanText(formData.get("follow_up_on"), 10),
  });
  if (!parsed.success) {
    const fieldErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const i of parsed.error.issues) fieldErrors[String(i.path[0])] ??= i.message;
    return { ok: false, message: "Please fix the highlighted fields.", fieldErrors };
  }

  const sb = await createClient();
  const { data: existing } = await sb.from("enquiries").select("status").eq("id", id).maybeSingle();
  if (!existing) return { ok: false, message: "This enquiry no longer exists." };

  const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {
    admin_notes: parsed.data.admin_notes || null,
    follow_up_on: parsed.data.follow_up_on || null,
  };
  // Only touch "status" when it really changed, so the status history stays clean.
  if (parsed.data.status !== existing.status) patch.status = parsed.data.status;

  const { error } = await sb.from("enquiries").update(patch).eq("id", id);
  if (error) return { ok: false, message: "Could not save. Try again." };

  await logActivity({
    adminId: session.userId,
    action: "update_enquiry",
    entityType: "enquiries",
    entityId: id,
    details: patch.status ? { status: parsed.data.status } : undefined,
  });
  revalidatePath("/admin/enquiries");
  revalidatePath(`/admin/enquiries/${id}`);
  revalidatePath("/admin");
  return { ok: true, message: "Saved." };
}

export async function deleteEnquiry(id: string) {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const sb = await createClient();
  const { data: images } = await sb.from("enquiry_images").select("storage_path").eq("enquiry_id", id);
  const { error } = await sb.from("enquiries").delete().eq("id", id);
  if (error) return;
  await removePrivateFiles((images ?? []).map((i: { storage_path: string }) => i.storage_path));
  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "delete_enquiry", entityType: "enquiries", entityId: id });
  revalidatePath("/admin/enquiries");
  revalidatePath("/admin");
  redirect("/admin/enquiries");
}

===== src\app\admin\(protected)\enquiries\page.tsx =====
import Link from "next/link";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { Badge } from "@/components/admin/data-table";
import { FilterChips, type Chip } from "@/components/admin/filter-chips";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/states/empty-state";
import {
  ENQUIRY_KINDS,
  ENQUIRY_KIND_LABELS,
  ENQUIRY_STATUSES,
  ENQUIRY_STATUS_LABELS,
  enquiryTone,
} from "@/lib/admin-status";
import { formatDate, todayIST } from "@/lib/admin-helpers";

export const metadata = { title: "Enquiries" };

type Row = {
  id: string;
  ref_code: string;
  kind: string;
  status: string;
  name: string;
  phone: string;
  service_type: string | null;
  follow_up_on: string | null;
  created_at: string;
};

function href(status?: string, kind?: string) {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  if (status) p.set("status", status);
  if (kind) p.set("kind", kind);
  const qs = p.toString();
  return qs ? `/admin/enquiries?${qs}` : "/admin/enquiries";
}

export default async function AdminEnquiriesPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ status?: string; kind?: string }>;
}) {
  await requireAdmin();
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const status = ENQUIRY_STATUSES.find((s) => s === sp.status);
  const kind = ENQUIRY_KINDS.find((k) => k === sp.kind);

  const sb = await createClient();
  let query = sb
    .from("enquiries")
    .select("id, ref_code, kind, status, name, phone, service_type, follow_up_on, created_at")
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(200);
  if (status) query = query.eq("status", status);
  if (kind) query = query.eq("kind", kind);
  const { data, error } = await query;
  const rows = (data ?? []) as Row[];
  const today = todayIST();

  const statusChips: Chip[] = [
    { label: "All statuses", href: href(undefined, kind), active: !status },
    ...ENQUIRY_STATUSES.map((s) => ({
      label: ENQUIRY_STATUS_LABELS[s],
      href: href(s, kind),
      active: status === s,
    })),
  ];
  const kindChips: Chip[] = [
    { label: "All types", href: href(status, undefined), active: !kind },
    ...ENQUIRY_KINDS.map((k) => ({ label: ENQUIRY_KIND_LABELS[k], href: href(status, k), active: kind === k })),
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      <h1 className="text-3xl text-charcoal">Enquiries</h1>
      <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-stone">
        Quotation requests, custom design requests and general enquiries from the website. Newest first.
      </p>

      <div className="mt-6 space-y-3">
        <FilterChips label="Filter by status" items={statusChips} />
        <FilterChips label="Filter by type" items={kindChips} />
      </div>

      <div className="mt-8">
        {error ? (
          <p role="alert" className="rounded-sm border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-red-800">
            Could not load enquiries.
          </p>
        ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            title={status || kind ? "No enquiries match this filter" : "No enquiries yet"}
            description={
              status || kind
                ? "Try another filter."
                : "When a customer sends a quote or design request, it will appear here."
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <ul className="divide-y divide-line rounded-sm border border-line">
            {rows.map((e) => {
              const due = e.follow_up_on && e.follow_up_on <= today && e.status !== "closed" && e.status !== "completed";
              return (
                <li key={e.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-3">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <Link href={`/admin/enquiries/${e.id}`} className="font-medium text-charcoal hover:text-gold-deep">
                      {e.name}
                    </Link>
                    <p className="text-sm text-stone">
                      {e.ref_code} Â· {ENQUIRY_KIND_LABELS[e.kind] ?? e.kind}
                      {e.service_type ? ` Â· ${e.service_type}` : ""} Â· {formatDate(e.created_at)}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    {due ? <Badge tone="warn">Follow up due</Badge> : null}
                    <Badge tone={enquiryTone(e.status)}>{ENQUIRY_STATUS_LABELS[e.status] ?? e.status}</Badge>
                  </div>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        )}
        {rows.length === 200 ? (
          <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-stone">Showing the latest 200. Use the filters to narrow down.</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\app\admin\(protected)\faqs\actions.ts =====
"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { z } from "zod";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { logActivity } from "@/lib/activity-log";
import { cleanText } from "@/lib/sanitize";
import type { FormState } from "@/lib/form-state";

const schema = z.object({
  question: z.string().min(5, "Enter the question.").max(300),
  answer: z.string().min(5, "Enter the answer.").max(3000),
  is_published: z.boolean(),
  sort_order: z.coerce.number().int().min(0).max(9999).default(0),
});

function readForm(formData: FormData) {
  return {
    question: cleanText(formData.get("question"), 300),
    answer: cleanText(formData.get("answer"), 3000),
    is_published: formData.get("is_published") === "on",
    sort_order: formData.get("sort_order") ?? 0,
  };
}

function fail(error: z.ZodError): FormState {
  const fieldErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const i of error.issues) fieldErrors[String(i.path[0])] ??= i.message;
  return { ok: false, message: "Please fix the highlighted fields.", fieldErrors };
}

function refresh() {
  revalidatePath("/admin/faqs");
  revalidatePath("/faq");
  revalidatePath("/");
}

export async function createFaq(_prev: FormState, formData: FormData): Promise<FormState> {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const parsed = schema.safeParse(readForm(formData));
  if (!parsed.success) return fail(parsed.error);

  const sb = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await sb.from("faqs").insert(parsed.data).select("id").single();
  if (error || !data) return { ok: false, message: "Could not save the FAQ." };

  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "create_faq", entityType: "faqs", entityId: data.id });
  refresh();
  redirect("/admin/faqs");
}

export async function updateFaq(id: string, _prev: FormState, formData: FormData): Promise<FormState> {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const parsed = schema.safeParse(readForm(formData));
  if (!parsed.success) return fail(parsed.error);

  const sb = await createClient();
  const { error } = await sb.from("faqs").update(parsed.data).eq("id", id);
  if (error) return { ok: false, message: "Could not save the FAQ." };

  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "update_faq", entityType: "faqs", entityId: id });
  refresh();
  return { ok: true, message: "Saved." };
}

export async function deleteFaq(id: string) {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const sb = await createClient();
  const { error } = await sb.from("faqs").delete().eq("id", id);
  if (error) return;
  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "delete_faq", entityType: "faqs", entityId: id });
  refresh();
  redirect("/admin/faqs");
}

===== src\app\admin\(protected)\faqs\faq-form.tsx =====
"use client";

import { useActionState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Field, Input, Textarea } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { FormMessage } from "@/components/admin/form-message";
import type { FormState } from "@/lib/form-state";

export type FaqFormValues = {
  question: string;
  answer: string;
  is_published: boolean;
  sort_order: number;
};

export function FaqForm({
  values,
  action,
  submitLabel,
}: {
  values: FaqFormValues;
  action: (prev: FormState, formData: FormData) => Promise<FormState>;
  submitLabel: string;
}) {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState<FormState, FormData>(action, null);
  const err = state?.fieldErrors ?? {};

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="max-w-2xl space-y-6" noValidate>
      <Field label="Question" htmlFor="question" error={err.question}>
        <Input id="question" name="question" defaultValue={values.question} required maxLength={300} />
      </Field>
      <Field label="Answer" htmlFor="answer" hint="Write only what is really true for your business." error={err.answer}>
        <Textarea id="answer" name="answer" defaultValue={values.answer} rows={6} maxLength={3000} required />
      </Field>
      <Field label="Sort order" htmlFor="sort_order" hint="Lower numbers show first." error={err.sort_order}>
        <Input
          id="sort_order"
          name="sort_order"
          type="number"
          min={0}
          max={9999}
          defaultValue={values.sort_order}
          className="max-w-32"
        />
      </Field>
      <Checkbox
        id="is_published"
        name="is_published"
        label="Published (visible on the website)"
        defaultChecked={values.is_published}
      />

      <FormMessage state={state} />

      <Button type="submit" size="lg" disabled={pending}>
        {pending ? "Saving" : submitLabel}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

===== src\app\admin\(protected)\projects\actions.ts =====
"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { z } from "zod";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { logActivity } from "@/lib/activity-log";
import { cleanText } from "@/lib/sanitize";
import { slugify } from "@/lib/slug";
import { deletePublicImage, uploadPublicImage } from "@/lib/upload";

export type FormState = { ok?: boolean; message?: string; fieldErrors?: Record<string, string> } | null;

const schema = z.object({
  title: z.string().min(2, "Enter a title.").max(120),
  location: z.string().max(120).optional().default(""),
  description: z.string().max(4000).optional().default(""),
  completed_on: z.string().optional().default(""),
  video_url: z
    .string()
    .max(300)
    .refine((v) => v === "" || /^https:\/\//.test(v), "Video link must start with https://")
    .optional()
    .default(""),
  service_id: z.string().optional().default(""),
  is_published: z.boolean(),
  is_featured: z.boolean(),
});

function readForm(formData: FormData) {
  return {
    title: cleanText(formData.get("title"), 120),
    location: cleanText(formData.get("location"), 120),
    description: cleanText(formData.get("description"), 4000),
    completed_on: String(formData.get("completed_on") ?? "").trim(),
    video_url: String(formData.get("video_url") ?? "").trim(),
    service_id: String(formData.get("service_id") ?? "").trim(),
    is_published: formData.get("is_published") === "on",
    is_featured: formData.get("is_featured") === "on",
  };
}

function toPatch(data: z.infer<typeof schema>) {
  return {
    title: data.title,
    location: data.location || null,
    description: data.description || null,
    completed_on: data.completed_on || null,
    video_url: data.video_url || null,
    service_id: data.service_id || null,
    is_published: data.is_published,
    is_featured: data.is_featured,
  };
}

async function uniqueSlug(sb: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createClient>>, base: string, excludeId?: string) {
  let slug = slugify(base) || "project";
  let n = 1;
  for (;;) {
    let q = sb.from("projects").select("id").eq("slug", slug);
    if (excludeId) q = q.neq("id", excludeId);
    const { data } = await q.maybeSingle();
    if (!data) return slug;
    n += 1;
    slug = `${slugify(base)}-${n}`;
  }
}

export async function createProject(_prev: FormState, formData: FormData): Promise<FormState> {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const parsed = schema.safeParse(readForm(formData));
  if (!parsed.success) {
    const fieldErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const i of parsed.error.issues) fieldErrors[String(i.path[0])] ??= i.message;
    return { ok: false, message: "Please fix the highlighted fields.", fieldErrors };
  }
  const sb = await createClient();
  const slug = await uniqueSlug(sb, parsed.data.title);
  const { data, error } = await sb
    .from("projects")
    .insert({ ...toPatch(parsed.data), slug })
    .select("id")
    .single();
  if (error || !data) return { ok: false, message: "Could not save the project." };

  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "create_project", entityType: "projects", entityId: data.id });
  revalidatePath("/projects");
  revalidatePath("/");
  redirect(`/admin/projects/${data.id}`);
}

export async function updateProject(id: string, _prev: FormState, formData: FormData): Promise<FormState> {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const parsed = schema.safeParse(readForm(formData));
  if (!parsed.success) {
    const fieldErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const i of parsed.error.issues) fieldErrors[String(i.path[0])] ??= i.message;
    return { ok: false, message: "Please fix the highlighted fields.", fieldErrors };
  }
  const sb = await createClient();
  const { data: existing } = await sb.from("projects").select("title, slug").eq("id", id).maybeSingle();
  if (!existing) return { ok: false, message: "This project no longer exists." };

  const patch: Record<string, unknown> = toPatch(parsed.data);
  if (parsed.data.title !== existing.title) patch.slug = await uniqueSlug(sb, parsed.data.title, id);

  const { error } = await sb.from("projects").update(patch).eq("id", id);
  if (error) return { ok: false, message: "Could not save the project." };

  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "update_project", entityType: "projects", entityId: id });
  revalidatePath("/projects");
  revalidatePath(`/projects/${(patch.slug as string) ?? existing.slug}`);
  revalidatePath("/");
  return { ok: true, message: "Saved." };
}

export async function deleteProject(id: string) {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const sb = await createClient();
  const { data: images } = await sb.from("project_images").select("storage_path").eq("project_id", id);
  const { error } = await sb.from("projects").delete().eq("id", id);
  if (error) return;
  await Promise.all((images ?? []).map((i) => deletePublicImage(i.storage_path)));
  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "delete_project", entityType: "projects", entityId: id });
  revalidatePath("/projects");
  revalidatePath("/");
  redirect("/admin/projects");
}

const KINDS = ["gallery", "before", "after"] as const;

export async function addProjectImage(projectId: string, _prev: FormState, formData: FormData): Promise<FormState> {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const file = formData.get("image") as File | null;
  const kind = String(formData.get("kind") ?? "gallery");
  if (!file || file.size === 0) return { ok: false, message: "Choose a photo to upload." };
  if (!KINDS.includes(kind as (typeof KINDS)[number])) return { ok: false, message: "Invalid photo type." };

  const result = await uploadPublicImage(file, `projects/${projectId}`);
  if ("error" in result) return { ok: false, message: result.error };

  const sb = await createClient();
  const { count } = await sb
    .from("project_images")
    .select("*", { count: "exact", head: true })
    .eq("project_id", projectId);
  const { error } = await sb
    .from("project_images")
    .insert({ project_id: projectId, storage_path: result.path, kind, sort_order: count ?? 0 });
  if (error) {
    await deletePublicImage(result.path);
    return { ok: false, message: "Could not save the photo." };
  }

  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "add_project_image", entityType: "projects", entityId: projectId });
  revalidatePath(`/admin/projects/${projectId}`);
  revalidatePath("/projects");
  return { ok: true, message: "Photo added." };
}

export async function deleteProjectImage(projectId: string, imageId: string) {
  await requireAdmin();
  const sb = await createClient();
  const { data } = await sb.from("project_images").select("storage_path").eq("id", imageId).maybeSingle();
  const { error } = await sb.from("project_images").delete().eq("id", imageId);
  if (error) return;
  await deletePublicImage(data?.storage_path);
  revalidatePath(`/admin/projects/${projectId}`);
  revalidatePath("/projects");
}

"use client";

import { useActionState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Field, Input, Textarea } from "@/components/ui/input";

import type { FormState } from "./actions";

export type ProjectFormValues = {
  title: string;
  location: string;
  description: string;
  completed_on: string;
  video_url: string;
  service_id: string;
  is_published: boolean;
  is_featured: boolean;

export function ProjectForm({
  values,
  services,
  action,
  submitLabel,
}: {
  values: ProjectFormValues;
  services: { id: string; title: string }[];
  action: (prev: FormState, formData: FormData) => Promise<FormState>;
  submitLabel: string;
}) {

  const err = state?.fieldErrors ?? {};

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="max-w-2xl space-y-6" noValidate>
      <Field label="Title" htmlFor="title" error={err.title}>

          <Select id="service_id" name="service_id" defaultValue={values.service_id}>
            <option value="">No specific service</option>
            {services.map((s) => (
              <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.title}</option>
            ))}
          </Select>
        </Field>
        <Field label="Completed on" htmlFor="completed_on" hint="Optional.">
          <Input id="completed_on" name="completed_on" type="date" defaultValue={values.completed_on} />
        </Field>
        <Field
          label="Video link"
          htmlFor="video_url"
          hint="Optional. YouTube or Vimeo link."
          error={err.video_url}
        >
          <Input id="video_url" name="video_url" type="url" defaultValue={values.video_url} placeholder="https://" />
        </Field>
      </div>
      <Field label="Description" htmlFor="description" error={err.description}>
        <Textarea id="description" name="description" defaultValue={values.description} rows={6} maxLength={4000} />
      </Field>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-6">
        <Checkbox id="is_published" name="is_published" label="Published" defaultChecked={values.is_published} />
        <Checkbox id="is_featured" name="is_featured" label="Featured on home page" defaultChecked={values.is_featured} />
      </div>

      {state?.message ? (
        <p
          role={state.ok ? "status" : "alert"}
          className={
            state.ok
              ? "rounded-sm border border-green-200 bg-green-50 px-3 py-2 text-green-900"
              : "rounded-sm border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-red-800"
          }
        >
          {state.message}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <Button type="submit" size="lg" disabled={pending}>
        {pending ? "Saving" : submitLabel}
      </Button>
    </form>

===== src\app\admin\(protected)\reviews\actions.ts =====
"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { logActivity } from "@/lib/activity-log";
import { REVIEW_STATUSES } from "@/lib/admin-status";
import { removePrivateFiles } from "@/lib/private-files";

function refresh() {
  revalidatePath("/admin/reviews");
  revalidatePath("/admin");
  revalidatePath("/reviews");
  revalidatePath("/");
}

export async function setReviewStatus(id: string, status: string) {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  if (!REVIEW_STATUSES.some((s) => s === status)) return;
  const sb = await createClient();
  const { error } = await sb
    .from("reviews")
    .update({ status, moderated_by: session.userId, moderated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
    .eq("id", id);
  if (error) return;
  await logActivity({
    adminId: session.userId,
    action: `review_${status}`,
    entityType: "reviews",
    entityId: id,
  });
  refresh();
}

export async function setReviewVerified(id: string, verified: boolean) {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const sb = await createClient();
  const { error } = await sb.from("reviews").update({ is_verified: verified }).eq("id", id);
  if (error) return;
  await logActivity({
    adminId: session.userId,
    action: verified ? "review_mark_verified" : "review_unmark_verified",
    entityType: "reviews",
    entityId: id,
  });
  refresh();
}

export async function deleteReview(id: string) {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const sb = await createClient();
  const { data: images } = await sb.from("review_images").select("storage_path").eq("review_id", id);
  const { error } = await sb.from("reviews").delete().eq("id", id);
  if (error) return;
  await removePrivateFiles((images ?? []).map((i: { storage_path: string }) => i.storage_path));
  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "delete_review", entityType: "reviews", entityId: id });
  refresh();
}

===== src\app\admin\(protected)\reviews\page.tsx =====
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { signedUrlsFor } from "@/lib/private-files";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/admin/data-table";
import { DeleteButton } from "@/components/admin/delete-button";
import { FilterChips, type Chip } from "@/components/admin/filter-chips";
import { PhotoGrid } from "@/components/admin/photo-grid";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/states/empty-state";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/admin-helpers";
import { deleteReview, setReviewStatus, setReviewVerified } from "./actions";

export const metadata = { title: "Reviews" };

type ReviewRow = {
  id: string;
  reviewer_name: string;
  reviewer_location: string | null;
  rating: number;
  body: string;
  status: "pending" | "approved" | "rejected";
  is_verified: boolean;
  created_at: string;
  projects: { title: string } | null;
  review_images: { id: string; storage_path: string }[] | null;
};

const TABS = ["pending", "approved", "rejected", "all"] as const;
const TAB_LABELS: Record<string, string> = { pending: "Waiting", approved: "Approved", rejected: "Rejected", all: "All" };

export default async function AdminReviewsPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<{ status?: string }> }) {
  await requireAdmin();
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const tab = TABS.find((t) => t === sp.status) ?? "pending";

  const sb = await createClient();
  const head = { count: "exact" as const, head: true };

  let query = sb
    .from("reviews")
    .select(
      "id, reviewer_name, reviewer_location, rating, body, status, is_verified, created_at, projects(title), review_images(id, storage_path)",
    )
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(100);
  if (tab !== "all") query = query.eq("status", tab);

  const [{ data, error }, pending, approved, rejected] = await Promise.all([
    query,
    sb.from("reviews").select("*", head).eq("status", "pending"),
    sb.from("reviews").select("*", head).eq("status", "approved"),
    sb.from("reviews").select("*", head).eq("status", "rejected"),
  ]);

  const rows = (data ?? []) as unknown as ReviewRow[];
  const urls = await signedUrlsFor(rows.flatMap((r) => (r.review_images ?? []).map((i) => i.storage_path)));
  const counts: Record<string, number | null> = {
    pending: pending.count,
    approved: approved.count,
    rejected: rejected.count,
    all: null,
  };

  const chips: Chip[] = TABS.map((t) => ({
    label: TAB_LABELS[t],
    href: `/admin/reviews?status=${t}`,
    active: tab === t,
    count: counts[t],
  }));

  return (
    <div>
      <h1 className="text-3xl text-charcoal">Reviews</h1>
      <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-stone">
        Only approved reviews appear on the website. Read each one before approving. Mark a review as
        &quot;verified&quot; only if the person really was your customer.
      </p>

      <div className="mt-6">
        <FilterChips label="Filter reviews" items={chips} />
      </div>

      <div className="mt-8">
        {error ? (
          <p role="alert" className="rounded-sm border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-red-800">
            Could not load reviews.
          </p>
        ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            title={tab === "pending" ? "No reviews waiting" : "No reviews here"}
            description="New reviews from customers will show up here for approval."
          />
        ) : (
          <ul className="space-y-4">
            {rows.map((r) => {
              const photos = (r.review_images ?? []).flatMap((i) => {
                const url = urls.get(i.storage_path);
                return url ? [{ id: i.id, url }] : [];
              });
              return (
                <li key={r.id} className="rounded-sm border border-line p-5">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <p className="font-medium text-charcoal">
                        {r.reviewer_name}
                        {r.reviewer_location ? (
                          <span className="font-normal text-stone"> Â· {r.reviewer_location}</span>
                        ) : null}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-sm text-stone">
                        <span aria-label={`${r.rating} out of 5 stars`} className="text-gold-deep">
                          {"â˜…".repeat(r.rating)}
                          {"â˜†".repeat(5 - r.rating)}
                        </span>{" "}
                        Â· {formatDate(r.created_at)}
                        {r.projects?.title ? ` Â· ${r.projects.title}` : ""}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                      <Badge tone={r.status === "approved" ? "good" : r.status === "pending" ? "warn" : "neutral"}>
                        {r.status === "pending" ? "Waiting" : r.status === "approved" ? "Approved" : "Rejected"}
                      </Badge>
                      {r.is_verified ? <Badge tone="good">Verified customer</Badge> : null}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <p className="mt-3 whitespace-pre-line break-words text-charcoal">{r.body}</p>
                  <PhotoGrid photos={photos} />

                  <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    {r.status !== "approved" ? (
                      <form action={setReviewStatus.bind(null, r.id, "approved")}>
                        <Button type="submit" size="sm">
                          Approve
                        </Button>
                      </form>
                    ) : null}
                    {r.status !== "rejected" ? (
                      <form action={setReviewStatus.bind(null, r.id, "rejected")}>
                        <Button type="submit" size="sm" variant="outline">
                          Reject
                        </Button>
                      </form>
                    ) : null}
                    {r.status !== "pending" ? (
                      <form action={setReviewStatus.bind(null, r.id, "pending")}>
                        <Button type="submit" size="sm" variant="ghost">
                          Move back to waiting
                        </Button>
                      </form>
                    ) : null}
                    <form action={setReviewVerified.bind(null, r.id, !r.is_verified)}>
                      <Button type="submit" size="sm" variant="ghost">
                        {r.is_verified ? "Remove verified" : "Mark as verified customer"}
                      </Button>
                    </form>
                    <form action={deleteReview.bind(null, r.id)}>
                      <DeleteButton confirm={`Delete the review from ${r.reviewer_name}? This cannot be undone.`} />
                    </form>
                  </div>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\app\admin\(protected)\service-areas\actions.ts =====
"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { z } from "zod";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { logActivity } from "@/lib/activity-log";
import { cleanText } from "@/lib/sanitize";
import type { FormState } from "@/lib/form-state";

const schema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(2, "Enter the area name.").max(80),
  sort_order: z.coerce.number().int().min(0).max(9999).default(0),
  is_active: z.boolean(),
});

function readForm(formData: FormData) {
  return {
    name: cleanText(formData.get("name"), 80),
    sort_order: formData.get("sort_order") ?? 0,
    is_active: formData.get("is_active") === "on",
  };
}

function refresh() {
  revalidatePath("/admin/service-areas");
  revalidatePath("/");
  revalidatePath("/contact");
}

export async function createServiceArea(_prev: FormState, formData: FormData): Promise<FormState> {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const parsed = schema.safeParse(readForm(formData));
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return { ok: false, message: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Check the details." };
  }

  const sb = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await sb.from("service_areas").insert(parsed.data).select("id").single();
  if (error) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: error.code === "23505" ? "This area is already in the list." : "Could not add the area.",
    };
  }

  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "create_service_area", entityType: "service_areas", entityId: data?.id });
  refresh();
  return { ok: true, message: "Area added." };
}

export async function updateServiceArea(id: string, _prev: FormState, formData: FormData): Promise<FormState> {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const parsed = schema.safeParse(readForm(formData));
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return { ok: false, message: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Check the details." };
  }

  const sb = await createClient();
  const { error } = await sb.from("service_areas").update(parsed.data).eq("id", id);
  if (error) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: error.code === "23505" ? "This area is already in the list." : "Could not save.",
    };
  }

  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "update_service_area", entityType: "service_areas", entityId: id });
  refresh();
  return { ok: true, message: "Saved." };
}

export async function deleteServiceArea(id: string) {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const sb = await createClient();
  const { error } = await sb.from("service_areas").delete().eq("id", id);
  if (error) return;
  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "delete_service_area", entityType: "service_areas", entityId: id });
  refresh();
}

===== src\app\admin\(protected)\service-areas\area-form.tsx =====
"use client";

import { useActionState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { FormMessage } from "@/components/admin/form-message";
import type { FormState } from "@/lib/form-state";

export function AreaForm({
  idPrefix,
  values,
  action,
  submitLabel,
  resetOnSuccess = false,
}: {
  idPrefix: string;
  values: { name: string; sort_order: number; is_active: boolean };
  action: (prev: FormState, formData: FormData) => Promise<FormState>;
  submitLabel: string;
  resetOnSuccess?: boolean;
}) {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState<FormState, FormData>(action, null);
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (resetOnSuccess && state?.ok) formRef.current?.reset();
  }, [state, resetOnSuccess]);

  return (
    <form ref={formRef} action={formAction} noValidate className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <Input
          name="name"
          aria-label="Area name"
          placeholder="Area name"
          defaultValue={values.name}
          maxLength={80}
          required
          className="w-56 max-w-full"
        />
        <Input
          name="sort_order"
          type="number"
          aria-label="Sort order (lower shows first)"
          title="Sort order (lower shows first)"
          min={0}
          max={9999}
          defaultValue={values.sort_order}
          className="w-24"
        />
        <Checkbox id={`${idPrefix}-active`} name="is_active" label="Shown" defaultChecked={values.is_active} />
        <Button type="submit" size="sm" disabled={pending}>
          {pending ? "Saving" : submitLabel}
        </Button>
      </div>
      <FormMessage state={state} />
    </form>
  );
}

===== src\app\admin\(protected)\services\actions.ts =====
"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { z } from "zod";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { logActivity } from "@/lib/activity-log";
import { cleanText } from "@/lib/sanitize";
import { slugify } from "@/lib/slug";
import { deletePublicImage, uploadPublicImage } from "@/lib/upload";

export type FormState = { ok?: boolean; message?: string; fieldErrors?: Record<string, string> } | null;

const schema = z.object({
  title: z.string().min(2, "Enter a title.").max(100),
  short_description: z.string().max(200).optional().default(""),
  description: z.string().max(4000).optional().default(""),
  is_published: z.boolean(),
  sort_order: z.coerce.number().int().min(0).max(9999).default(0),
});

function readForm(formData: FormData) {
  return {
    title: cleanText(formData.get("title"), 100),
    short_description: cleanText(formData.get("short_description"), 200),
    description: cleanText(formData.get("description"), 4000),
    is_published: formData.get("is_published") === "on",
    sort_order: formData.get("sort_order") ?? 0,
  };
}

async function uniqueSlug(sb: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createClient>>, base: string, excludeId?: string) {
  let slug = slugify(base) || "service";
  let n = 1;
  for (;;) {
    let q = sb.from("services").select("id").eq("slug", slug);
    if (excludeId) q = q.neq("id", excludeId);
    const { data } = await q.maybeSingle();
    if (!data) return slug;
    n += 1;
    slug = `${slugify(base)}-${n}`;
  }
}

export async function createService(_prev: FormState, formData: FormData): Promise<FormState> {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const parsed = schema.safeParse(readForm(formData));
  if (!parsed.success) {
    const fieldErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const i of parsed.error.issues) fieldErrors[String(i.path[0])] ??= i.message;
    return { ok: false, message: "Please fix the highlighted fields.", fieldErrors };
  }

  const sb = await createClient();
  const slug = await uniqueSlug(sb, parsed.data.title);

  let cover_image_path: string | null = null;
  const image = formData.get("cover_image") as File | null;
  if (image && image.size > 0) {
    const result = await uploadPublicImage(image, "services");
    if ("error" in result) return { ok: false, message: result.error };
    cover_image_path = result.path;
  }

  const { data, error } = await sb
    .from("services")
    .insert({ ...parsed.data, slug, cover_image_path })
    .select("id")
    .single();
  if (error || !data) return { ok: false, message: "Could not save the service." };

  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "create_service", entityType: "services", entityId: data.id });
  revalidatePath("/services");
  revalidatePath("/");
  redirect("/admin/services");
}

export async function updateService(id: string, _prev: FormState, formData: FormData): Promise<FormState> {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const parsed = schema.safeParse(readForm(formData));
  if (!parsed.success) {
    const fieldErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const i of parsed.error.issues) fieldErrors[String(i.path[0])] ??= i.message;
    return { ok: false, message: "Please fix the highlighted fields.", fieldErrors };
  }

  const sb = await createClient();
  const { data: existing } = await sb.from("services").select("title, cover_image_path").eq("id", id).maybeSingle();
  if (!existing) return { ok: false, message: "This service no longer exists." };

  const patch: Record<string, unknown> = { ...parsed.data };
  if (parsed.data.title !== existing.title) {
    patch.slug = await uniqueSlug(sb, parsed.data.title, id);
  }

  const image = formData.get("cover_image") as File | null;
  const removeCover = formData.get("remove_cover_image") === "on";
  if (image && image.size > 0) {
    const result = await uploadPublicImage(image, "services");
    if ("error" in result) return { ok: false, message: result.error };
    patch.cover_image_path = result.path;
    await deletePublicImage(existing.cover_image_path);
  } else if (removeCover) {
    patch.cover_image_path = null;
    await deletePublicImage(existing.cover_image_path);
  }

  const { error } = await sb.from("services").update(patch).eq("id", id);
  if (error) return { ok: false, message: "Could not save the service." };

  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "update_service", entityType: "services", entityId: id });
  revalidatePath("/services");
  revalidatePath(`/services/${(patch.slug as string) ?? existing.title}`);
  revalidatePath("/");
  return { ok: true, message: "Saved." };
}

export async function deleteService(id: string) {
  const session = await requireAdmin();
  const sb = await createClient();
  const { data } = await sb.from("services").select("cover_image_path").eq("id", id).maybeSingle();
  const { error } = await sb.from("services").delete().eq("id", id);
  if (error) return;
  if (data?.cover_image_path) await deletePublicImage(data.cover_image_path);
  await logActivity({ adminId: session.userId, action: "delete_service", entityType: "services", entityId: id });
  revalidatePath("/services");
  revalidatePath("/");
  redirect("/admin/services");
}

export function ServiceForm({

import { notFound } from "next/navigation";

===== src\app\admin\(protected)\settings\actions.ts =====
"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { z } from "zod";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { logActivity } from "@/lib/activity-log";
import { cleanText } from "@/lib/sanitize";

export type SettingsState = {
  ok?: boolean;
  message?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Partial<Record<string, string>>;
} | null;

const emptyToNull = (v: string) => (v === "" ? null : v);

const schema = z.object({
  business_name: z.string().min(2, "Enter the business name.").max(100),
  tagline: z.string().min(2, "Enter a tagline.").max(150),
  phone: z
    .string()
    .max(20)
    .regex(/^([+0-9][0-9 -]{5,19})?$/, "Use digits only, for example +91 98765 43210.")
    .transform(emptyToNull),
  whatsapp_number: z
    .string()
    .transform((v) => v.replace(/\D/g, ""))
    .refine((v) => v === "" || /^[0-9]{10,15}$/.test(v), "Enter country code and number, 10 to 15 digits.")
    .transform(emptyToNull),
  email: z.string().max(254).email("Enter a valid email address.").or(z.literal("")).transform(emptyToNull),
  address: z.string().max(500).transform(emptyToNull),
  working_hours: z.string().max(200).transform(emptyToNull),
  map_embed_url: z
    .string()
    .max(1000)
    .refine((v) => v === "" || v.startsWith("https://www.google.com/maps/embed"), "Paste the Google Maps embed link (it starts with https://www.google.com/maps/embed).")
    .transform(emptyToNull),
});

export async function saveSettings(_prev: SettingsState, formData: FormData): Promise<SettingsState> {
  const session = await requireAdmin();

  const raw = {
    business_name: cleanText(formData.get("business_name"), 100),
    tagline: cleanText(formData.get("tagline"), 150),
    phone: cleanText(formData.get("phone"), 20),
    whatsapp_number: cleanText(formData.get("whatsapp_number"), 30),
    email: cleanText(formData.get("email"), 254),
    address: cleanText(formData.get("address"), 500),
    working_hours: cleanText(formData.get("working_hours"), 200),
    map_embed_url: String(formData.get("map_embed_url") ?? "").trim(),
  };

  const parsed = schema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    const fieldErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) {
      const key = String(issue.path[0]);
      fieldErrors[key] ??= issue.message;
    }
    return { ok: false, message: "Please fix the highlighted fields.", fieldErrors };
  }

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { error } = await supabase.from("business_settings").update(parsed.data).eq("id", true);
  if (error) {
    return { ok: false, message: "Could not save. Check that supabase/setup.sql has been run, then try again." };
  }

  await logActivity({
    adminId: session.userId,
    action: "update_business_settings",
    entityType: "business_settings",
    details: { fields: Object.keys(parsed.data) },
  });

  // Show the new details on the public site straight away.
  revalidatePath("/", "layout");
  return { ok: true, message: "Saved. The website now shows these details." };
}
