===== src\app\admin\(protected)\settings\settings-form.tsx =====
"use client";

import { useActionState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Field, Input, Textarea } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { saveSettings, type SettingsState } from "./actions";

export type SettingsValues = {
  business_name: string;
  tagline: string;
  phone: string;
  whatsapp_number: string;
  email: string;
  address: string;
  working_hours: string;
  map_embed_url: string;
};

export function SettingsForm({ values }: { values: SettingsValues }) {
  const [state, action, pending] = useActionState<SettingsState, FormData>(saveSettings, null);
  const err = state?.fieldErrors ?? {};

  return (
    <form action={action} className="space-y-6" noValidate>
      <div className="grid gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <Field label="Business name" htmlFor="business_name" error={err.business_name}>
          <Input id="business_name" name="business_name" defaultValue={values.business_name} required />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Tagline" htmlFor="tagline" error={err.tagline}>
          <Input id="tagline" name="tagline" defaultValue={values.tagline} required />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Phone" htmlFor="phone" hint="Shown on the website and used for the call button." error={err.phone}>
          <Input id="phone" name="phone" type="tel" defaultValue={values.phone} placeholder="+91 98765 43210" />
        </Field>
        <Field label="WhatsApp number" htmlFor="whatsapp_number" hint="Country code first, no plus sign. Example: 919876543210." error={err.whatsapp_number}>
          <Input id="whatsapp_number" name="whatsapp_number" inputMode="numeric" defaultValue={values.whatsapp_number} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Email" htmlFor="email" error={err.email}>
          <Input id="email" name="email" type="email" defaultValue={values.email} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Working hours" htmlFor="working_hours" error={err.working_hours}>
          <Input id="working_hours" name="working_hours" defaultValue={values.working_hours} placeholder="Mon to Sat, 9 am to 7 pm" />
        </Field>
      </div>
      <Field label="Business address" htmlFor="address" error={err.address}>
        <Textarea id="address" name="address" defaultValue={values.address} rows={3} />
      </Field>
      <Field
        label="Google Maps embed link"
        htmlFor="map_embed_url"
        hint="Google Maps, Share, Embed a map, copy the src link from the code."
        error={err.map_embed_url}
      >
        <Input id="map_embed_url" name="map_embed_url" defaultValue={values.map_embed_url} />
      </Field>

      {state?.message ? (
        <p
          role={state.ok ? "status" : "alert"}
          className={
            state.ok
              ? "rounded-sm border border-green-200 bg-green-50 px-3 py-2 text-green-900"
              : "rounded-sm border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-red-800"
          }
        >
          {state.message}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <Button type="submit" size="lg" disabled={pending}>
        {pending ? "Saving" : "Save settings"}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

export function Badge({ tone, children }: { tone: "good" | "neutral" | "warn"; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const toneClass =
    tone === "good"
      ? "bg-green-100 text-green-900"
      : tone === "warn"
        ? "bg-amber-100 text-amber-900"
        : "bg-beige text-stone";
  return <span className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-sm px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium ${toneClass}`}>{children}</span>;
}

    />
  );

/** Submit button for a delete form. Confirms with the browser before submitting. */
export function DeleteButton({ confirm, label = "Delete" }: { confirm: string; label?: string }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="submit"
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (!window.confirm(confirm)) e.preventDefault();
      }}

    >
      {label}
    </button>
  );
}

export type DetailItem = { label: string; value: ReactNode | null | undefined };

/** Label/value list. Rows with no value are left out. */
export function DetailList({ items }: { items: DetailItem[] }) {

===== src\components\admin\notify-whatsapp.tsx =====
"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { MessageCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { ENQUIRY_STATUS_LABELS } from "@/lib/admin-status";
import { buildStatusMessage, NOTIFY_STATUSES, type NotifyEnquiry } from "@/lib/notify-templates";
import { whatsappLink } from "@/lib/admin-helpers";

/**
 * Lets the admin send the customer a WhatsApp update for the current enquiry.
 * Nothing is sent automatically: choosing a status only fills in a suggested message,
 * which the admin can edit, and WhatsApp only opens after the admin clicks the button.
 */
export function NotifyWhatsapp({
  phone,
  businessName,
  enquiry,
  currentStatus,
}: {
  phone: string;
  businessName: string;
  enquiry: NotifyEnquiry;
  currentStatus: string;
}) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState(currentStatus);
  const defaultMessage = useMemo(() => buildStatusMessage(status, businessName, enquiry), [status, businessName, enquiry]);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState(defaultMessage);
  const [edited, setEdited] = useState(false);

  function handleStatusChange(next: string) {
    setStatus(next);
    if (!edited) setMessage(buildStatusMessage(next, businessName, enquiry));
  }

  const href = whatsappLink(phone) + `?text=${encodeURIComponent(message)}`;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-sm border border-line bg-beige/40 p-5">
      <h3 className="text-lg text-charcoal">Notify customer on WhatsApp</h3>
      <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-stone">
        Choose what to tell the customer. You can change the words below before sending.
      </p>

      <div className="mt-4 max-w-xs">
        <Select
          aria-label="Message for"
          value={status}
          onChange={(e) => handleStatusChange(e.target.value)}
        >
          {NOTIFY_STATUSES.map((s) => (
            <option key={s} value={s}>
              {ENQUIRY_STATUS_LABELS[s] ?? s}
            </option>
          ))}
        </Select>
      </div>

      <Textarea
        aria-label="WhatsApp message"
        rows={4}
        value={message}
        onChange={(e) => {
          setMessage(e.target.value);
          setEdited(true);
        }}
        className="mt-3"
      />

      <Button asChild variant="whatsapp" className="mt-3">
        <a href={href} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
          <MessageCircle aria-hidden="true" />
          Open WhatsApp with this message
        </a>
      </Button>
      <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-stone">
        This opens WhatsApp with the message ready. You still have to press send there.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

export function EnquiryForm({

===== src\components\forms\photo-picker.tsx =====
"use client";

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { compressImage } from "@/lib/compress-image";

type Item = { id: string; file: File; preview: string };

/**
 * Lets the customer choose photos. Each photo is shrunk in the browser first.
 * The chosen files are passed up through onChange; the form adds them when it is sent.
 */
export function PhotoPicker({
  max,
  onChange,
  onBusyChange,
  error,
}: {
  max: number;
  onChange: (files: File[]) => void;
  onBusyChange?: (busy: boolean) => void;
  error?: string;
}) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Item[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  function publish(next: Item[]) {
    setItems(next);
    onChange(next.map((i) => i.file));
  }

  async function handleSelect(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const selected = Array.from(e.target.files ?? []);
    e.target.value = "";
    if (selected.length === 0) return;

    const room = max - items.length;
    if (room <= 0) {
      setNote(`You can add up to ${max} photos.`);
      return;
    }

    setBusy(true);
    onBusyChange?.(true);
    setNote("");

    const added: Item[] = [];
    const failed: string[] = [];
    for (const file of selected.slice(0, room)) {
      try {
        const small = await compressImage(file);
        added.push({ id: `${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`, file: small, preview: URL.createObjectURL(small) });
      } catch {
        failed.push(file.name);
      }
    }
    publish([...items, ...added]);

    const messages: string[] = [];
    if (failed.length > 0) messages.push(`Could not read ${failed.join(", ")}. Use a JPG, PNG or WEBP photo.`);
    if (selected.length > room) messages.push(`Only ${max} photos can be added.`);
    setNote(messages.join(" "));

    setBusy(false);
    onBusyChange?.(false);
  }

  function remove(id: string) {
    const gone = items.find((i) => i.id === id);
    if (gone) URL.revokeObjectURL(gone.preview);
    publish(items.filter((i) => i.id !== id));
    setNote("");
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <span className="block text-sm font-medium text-charcoal">Photos (optional)</span>
      <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-stone">
        Add up to {max} photos of the room. They are made smaller on your phone before sending.
      </p>

      {items.length > 0 ? (
        <ul className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
          {items.map((item) => (
            <li key={item.id} className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-sm border border-line">
              {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
              <img src={item.preview} alt="Selected photo" className="aspect-square w-full object-cover" />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => remove(item.id)}
                className="absolute right-1 top-1 rounded-sm bg-charcoal/85 px-2 py-1 text-xs text-warm-white hover:bg-charcoal"
              >
                Remove
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : null}

      <input
        ref={inputRef}
        type="file"
        accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
        multiple
        disabled={busy || items.length >= max}
        onChange={handleSelect}
        aria-label="Choose photos"
        className="mt-3 block w-full text-sm text-stone file:mr-4 file:h-11 file:rounded-sm file:border-0 file:bg-charcoal file:px-4 file:text-warm-white disabled:opacity-50"
      />
      {busy ? (
        <p role="status" className="mt-2 text-sm text-stone">
          Preparing photosâ€¦
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {note ? (
        <p role="alert" className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-700">
          {note}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {error ? (
        <p role="alert" className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-700">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

import { Star } from "lucide-react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Card, CardHeader, CardDescription, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Section } from "@/components/layout/section";

export type ReviewItem = {
  id: string;
  reviewer_name: string;
  reviewer_location: string | null;
  rating: number;
  body: string;
  is_verified: boolean;
};

interface ClientReviewsProps {
  reviews: ReviewItem[];
}

export function ClientReviews({ reviews }: ClientReviewsProps) {
  // If there are no approved reviews, completely hide the section.
  // Never fabricate or invent reviews.
  if (!reviews || reviews.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <Section tone="beige" id="reviews">
      <div>
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gold-deep">
          Testimonials
        </span>
        <h2 className="mt-2 text-3xl text-charcoal sm:text-4xl">Client Reviews</h2>
        <p className="mt-3 max-w-2xl text-stone">
          Feedback from verified homeowners and property managers who worked with us.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-10 grid gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {reviews.map((rev) => (
          <Card key={rev.id} className="flex flex-col justify-between">
            <CardHeader>
              <div
                className="flex items-center gap-1 text-gold"
                aria-label={`${rev.rating} out of 5 stars`}
              >
                {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, i) => (
                  <Star

                      i < rev.rating ? "fill-gold text-gold" : "text-line"

                  />
                ))}
              </div>
              <CardDescription className="mt-4 text-base italic leading-relaxed text-charcoal">

              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="pt-0">
              <div className="border-t border-line/70 pt-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="truncate font-medium text-charcoal">{rev.reviewer_name}</p>
                    {rev.reviewer_location ? (
                      <p className="truncate text-xs text-stone">{rev.reviewer_location}</p>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                  {rev.is_verified ? (
                    <Badge variant="gold" className="shrink-0 text-[10px]">
                      Verified
                    </Badge>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </div>
    </Section>
  );
}

/**
 * Hero illustration: plan view of a tray ceiling with cove lighting.
 * It is a drawing, not a photo of real work, and is captioned that way.
 * Animation (see globals.css): the gold cove line draws, then the glow rises.
 */
export function HeroCeiling() {
  const ink = "var(--color-charcoal)";
  const faint = "var(--color-line)";
  const gold = "var(--color-gold)";

  return (
    <figure className="mx-auto w-full max-w-md lg:max-w-none">
      <svg
        viewBox="0 0 480 520"
        role="img"
        aria-label="Illustration of a POP tray ceiling seen from below, with a gold line of cove lighting"
        className="h-auto w-full"
      >
        <defs>
          <filter id="cove-blur" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
            <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="9" />
          </filter>
        </defs>

        {/* Room and plaster surfaces */}
        <rect x="20" y="20" width="440" height="480" fill="var(--color-beige)" stroke={faint} strokeWidth="1.5" />
        <rect x="56" y="56" width="368" height="408" fill="var(--color-warm-white)" stroke={ink} strokeWidth="1" />
        <rect x="140" y="140" width="200" height="240" fill="var(--color-beige)" stroke={ink} strokeWidth="1" />

        {/* Depth lines from outer corners to the recessed tray */}
        <g stroke={faint} strokeWidth="1">
          <line x1="56" y1="56" x2="104" y2="104" />
          <line x1="424" y1="56" x2="376" y2="104" />
          <line x1="56" y1="464" x2="104" y2="416" />
          <line x1="424" y1="464" x2="376" y2="416" />
          <line x1="104" y1="104" x2="140" y2="140" />
          <line x1="376" y1="104" x2="340" y2="140" />
          <line x1="104" y1="416" x2="140" y2="380" />
          <line x1="376" y1="416" x2="340" y2="380" />
        </g>

        {/* Cove light: soft glow behind, crisp line on top */}
        <rect
          className="cove-glow"
          x="104" y="104" width="272" height="312"
          fill="none" stroke={gold} strokeWidth="14" filter="url(#cove-blur)" opacity="0.55"
        />
        <rect
          className="cove-line"
          pathLength="1"
          x="104" y="104" width="272" height="312"
          fill="none" stroke={gold} strokeWidth="2.5"
        />

        {/* Centre rose */}
        <g fill="none" stroke={ink} strokeWidth="1">
          <circle cx="240" cy="260" r="46" />
          <circle cx="240" cy="260" r="30" />
          <circle cx="240" cy="260" r="6" fill={gold} stroke="none" />

      <figcaption className="mt-3 text-sm text-stone">
        Illustration: POP tray ceiling with cove lighting, seen from below.

===== src\components\layout\floating-whatsapp.tsx =====
"use client";

import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { MessageCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { buildEnquiryMessage, buildWhatsAppLink } from "@/lib/whatsapp";

/**
 * Floating WhatsApp button shown on every public page.
 * The prefilled message includes the page the visitor is on.
 */
export function FloatingWhatsApp({
  whatsappNumber,
  siteUrl,
}: {
  whatsappNumber: string;
  siteUrl: string;
}) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  if (pathname.startsWith("/admin")) return null;

  const isHome = pathname === "/";
  const message = isHome
    ? buildEnquiryMessage({ kind: "general" })
    : `${buildEnquiryMessage({ kind: "general" })}\nI was looking at: ${siteUrl}${pathname}`;

  return (
    <a
      href={buildWhatsAppLink({ whatsappNumber, message })}
      target="_blank"
      rel="noopener noreferrer"
      aria-label="Chat with us on WhatsApp"
      className="fixed bottom-5 right-5 z-50 inline-flex h-14 items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-whatsapp px-5 text-white shadow-lg transition-colors hover:bg-whatsapp-deep focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-gold"
    >
      <MessageCircle className="size-6" aria-hidden="true" />
      <span className="hidden text-[0.95rem] font-medium sm:inline">WhatsApp</span>
    </a>
  );
}

===== src\components\layout\site-header.tsx =====
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Menu, X } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Container } from "./container";
import { primaryNav, secondaryNav } from "./nav-links";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function SiteHeader({ name }: { name: string }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  // Mobile menu closes on link tap (onClick below) and on Escape.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.key === "Escape" && setOpen(false);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
    };
  }, [open]);

  const isActive = (href: string) => pathname === href || pathname.startsWith(href + "/");

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 border-b border-line bg-warm-white/95 backdrop-blur">
      <Container className="flex h-16 items-center justify-between gap-6">
        <Link href="/" className="font-serif text-xl leading-none text-charcoal">
          {name}
        </Link>

        <nav aria-label="Main" className="hidden items-center gap-7 lg:flex">
          {primaryNav.map((item) => (
            <Link
              key={item.href}
              href={item.href}
              aria-current={isActive(item.href) ? "page" : undefined}
              className={cn(
                "text-[0.95rem] text-stone transition-colors hover:text-charcoal",
                isActive(item.href) && "text-charcoal underline decoration-gold decoration-2 underline-offset-8",
              )}
            >
              {item.label}
            </Link>
          ))}
        </nav>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button asChild size="sm" className="hidden sm:inline-flex">
            <Link href="/quote">Get Free Quote</Link>
          </Button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="inline-flex size-11 items-center justify-center rounded-sm text-charcoal hover:bg-beige lg:hidden"
            aria-label={open ? "Close menu" : "Open menu"}
            aria-expanded={open}
            aria-controls="mobile-menu"
            onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
          >
            {open ? <X className="size-6" /> : <Menu className="size-6" />}
          </button>
        </div>
      </Container>

      {open ? (
        <div
          id="mobile-menu"
          className="fixed inset-x-0 top-16 bottom-0 overflow-y-auto bg-warm-white lg:hidden"
        >
          <nav aria-label="Mobile" className="px-5 pb-10 pt-4">
            <ul className="divide-y divide-line">
              {[{ href: "/", label: "Home" }, ...primaryNav, ...secondaryNav].map((item) => (
                <li key={item.href}>
                  <Link
                    href={item.href}
                    onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
                    aria-current={pathname === item.href ? "page" : undefined}
                    className={cn(
                      "block py-4 font-serif text-2xl text-charcoal",
                      pathname === item.href && "text-gold-deep",
                    )}
                  >
                    {item.label}
                  </Link>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
            <Button asChild size="lg" className="mt-8 w-full">
              <Link href="/quote" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Get Free Quote</Link>
            </Button>
          </nav>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </header>
  );
}

===== src\components\shared\before-after-slider.tsx =====
"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { useState } from "react";

/**
 * Drag, touch or use the arrow keys to compare before and after.
 * The range input covers the image, so it works with mouse, touch and keyboard.
 */
export function BeforeAfterSlider({
  beforeSrc,
  afterSrc,
  beforeAlt,
  afterAlt,
}: {
  beforeSrc: string;
  afterSrc: string;
  beforeAlt: string;
  afterAlt: string;
}) {
  const [pos, setPos] = useState(50);

  return (
    <div className="relative aspect-[4/3] w-full select-none overflow-hidden bg-beige">
      <Image src={afterSrc} alt={afterAlt} fill sizes="(min-width: 1024px) 66vw, 100vw" className="object-cover" />
      <div className="absolute inset-0" style={{ clipPath: `inset(0 ${100 - pos}% 0 0)` }}>
        <Image src={beforeSrc} alt={beforeAlt} fill sizes="(min-width: 1024px) 66vw, 100vw" className="object-cover" />
      </div>

      <span className="absolute left-3 top-3 rounded-sm bg-charcoal/80 px-2 py-1 text-xs text-warm-white">Before</span>
      <span className="absolute right-3 top-3 rounded-sm bg-charcoal/80 px-2 py-1 text-xs text-warm-white">After</span>

      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 w-0.5 bg-gold"
        style={{ left: `${pos}%` }}
      >
        <span className="absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 size-9 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full border-2 border-gold bg-warm-white" />
      </div>

      <input
        type="range"
        min={0}
        max={100}
        value={pos}
        onChange={(e) => setPos(Number(e.target.value))}
        aria-label="Compare before and after photos"
        className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full cursor-ew-resize opacity-0"
      />
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\components\shared\contact-buttons.tsx =====
import { MessageCircle, Phone } from "lucide-react";
import { Button, type ButtonProps } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { telHref, type BusinessSettings } from "@/lib/business-settings";
import { buildEnquiryMessage, buildWhatsAppLink } from "@/lib/whatsapp";

/** WhatsApp button with a prefilled message containing the item name and its full link. */
export function WhatsAppLink({
  settings,
  kind = "general",
  itemName,
  path,
  label = "WhatsApp",
  variant = "whatsapp",
  size,
}: {
  settings: BusinessSettings;
  kind?: "design" | "project" | "service" | "general";
  itemName?: string;
  path?: string;
  label?: string;
  variant?: ButtonProps["variant"];
  size?: ButtonProps["size"];
}) {
  const href = buildWhatsAppLink({
    whatsappNumber: settings.whatsappNumber,
    message: buildEnquiryMessage({
      kind,
      itemName,
      url: path ? `${settings.siteUrl}${path}` : undefined,
    }),
  });
  return (
    <Button asChild variant={variant} size={size}>
      <a href={href} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
        <MessageCircle aria-hidden="true" />
        {label}
      </a>
    </Button>
  );
}

/** Click-to-call button. Renders nothing until a real phone number is set. */
export function CallLink({
  settings,
  variant = "outline",
  size,
}: {
  settings: BusinessSettings;
  variant?: ButtonProps["variant"];
  size?: ButtonProps["size"];
}) {
  const href = telHref(settings);
  if (!href) return null;
  return (
    <Button asChild variant={variant} size={size}>
      <a href={href}>
        <Phone aria-hidden="true" />
        Call us
      </a>
    </Button>
  );
}

===== src\components\shared\favourite-button.tsx =====
"use client";

import { Heart } from "lucide-react";
import { toggleFavourite, useFavourites } from "@/lib/favourites";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/** Save a design on this device. variant "icon" sits on a card, "full" is a labelled button. */
export function FavouriteButton({
  slug,
  title,
  variant = "icon",
}: {
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  variant?: "icon" | "full";
}) {
  const saved = useFavourites().includes(slug);
  const label = saved ? `Remove ${title} from saved designs` : `Save ${title}`;

  if (variant === "full") {
    return (
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => toggleFavourite(slug)}
        aria-pressed={saved}
        className="inline-flex h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-sm border border-charcoal/70 px-6 text-[0.95rem] font-medium text-charcoal hover:bg-beige"
      >
        <Heart aria-hidden="true" className={cn("size-4", saved && "fill-gold text-gold")} />
        {saved ? "Saved" : "Save design"}
      </button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={() => toggleFavourite(slug)}
      aria-pressed={saved}
      aria-label={label}
      className="absolute right-2 top-2 inline-flex size-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-warm-white/90 text-charcoal shadow-sm hover:bg-warm-white"
    >
      <Heart aria-hidden="true" className={cn("size-5", saved && "fill-gold text-gold")} />
    </button>
  );
}

===== src\components\shared\item-image.tsx =====
import Image from "next/image";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { publicMediaUrl } from "@/lib/storage";

/**
 * A photo from the public bucket, or a calm placeholder block when there is no photo yet.
 * Give it an aspect ratio through className, for example "aspect-[4/3]".
 */
export function ItemImage({
  path,
  alt,
  sizes = "(min-width: 1024px) 33vw, (min-width: 640px) 50vw, 100vw",
  className,
  priority = false,
}: {
  path: string | null | undefined;
  alt: string;
  sizes?: string;
  className?: string;
  priority?: boolean;
}) {
  const src = publicMediaUrl(path);
  return (
    <div className={cn("relative overflow-hidden bg-beige", className)}>
      {src ? (
        <Image src={src} alt={alt} fill sizes={sizes} priority={priority} className="object-cover" />
      ) : (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
          <span className="text-sm text-stone">Photo coming soon</span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\components\shared\json-ld.tsx =====
/** Structured data for search engines. Only pass real, verified facts. */
export function JsonLd({ data }: { data: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  return (
    <script
      type="application/ld+json"
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: JSON.stringify(data).replace(/</g, "\\u003c") }}
    />
  );
}

===== src\components\shared\pagination.tsx =====
import Link from "next/link";

export function Pagination({
  page,
  totalPages,
  hrefFor,
}: {
  page: number;
  totalPages: number;
  hrefFor: (page: number) => string;
}) {
  if (totalPages <= 1) return null;
  const linkClass =
    "inline-flex h-11 min-w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-sm border border-line px-4 text-charcoal hover:bg-beige";
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Pagination" className="mt-12 flex items-center justify-center gap-3">
      {page > 1 ? (
        <Link href={hrefFor(page - 1)} className={linkClass} rel="prev">
          Previous
        </Link>
      ) : null}
      <span className="text-stone" aria-current="page">
        Page {page} of {totalPages}
      </span>
      {page < totalPages ? (
        <Link href={hrefFor(page + 1)} className={linkClass} rel="next">
          Next
        </Link>
      ) : null}
    </nav>
  );
}

===== src\components\shared\share-button.tsx =====
"use client";

import { Share2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";

/** Uses the phone share sheet when available, otherwise copies the link. */
export function ShareButton({ title, url }: { title: string; url: string }) {
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");

  async function share() {
    try {
      if (navigator.share) {
        await navigator.share({ title, url });
        return;
      }
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
      setMessage("Link copied");
    } catch {
      setMessage("Could not share. Copy the link from the address bar.");
    }
  }

  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-3">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={share}
        className="inline-flex h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-sm px-4 text-[0.95rem] font-medium text-charcoal hover:bg-beige"
      >
        <Share2 aria-hidden="true" className="size-4" />
        Share
      </button>
      <span role="status" className="text-sm text-stone">
        {message}
      </span>
    </span>
  );
}

import { Star } from "lucide-react";

export function StarRating({ rating }: { rating: number }) {
  const value = Math.max(0, Math.min(5, Math.round(rating)));
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5" role="img" aria-label={`${value} out of 5 stars`}>
      {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, i) => (
        <Star
          key={i}
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={i < value ? "size-4 fill-gold text-gold" : "size-4 text-line"}
        />
      ))}
    </span>
  );
}

import * as React from "react";
import { Slot } from "@radix-ui/react-slot";
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const buttonVariants = cva(
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-sm text-[0.95rem] font-medium tracking-wide transition-colors focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-gold disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-charcoal text-warm-white hover:bg-charcoal-soft",
        gold: "bg-gold text-charcoal hover:bg-gold-deep hover:text-warm-white",
        outline:
          "border border-charcoal/70 text-charcoal hover:bg-charcoal hover:text-warm-white",
        ghost: "text-charcoal hover:bg-beige",
        whatsapp: "bg-whatsapp text-white hover:bg-whatsapp-deep",
      },
      size: {
        default: "h-11 px-6",
        sm: "h-9 px-4 text-sm",
        lg: "h-12 px-8 text-base",
        icon: "size-11",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: { variant: "default", size: "default" },
  },
);

export interface ButtonProps
  extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>,
    VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> {
  asChild?: boolean;
}

export function Button({
  className,
  variant,
  size,
  asChild = false,
  ...props
}: ButtonProps) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : "button";
  return (
    <Comp className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size }), className)} {...props} />
  );
}

export { buttonVariants };

===== src\lib\activity-log.ts =====
import "server-only";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";

/** Records an admin action in admin_activity_logs. Never throws. */
export async function logActivity(opts: {
  adminId: string;
  action: string;
  entityType?: string;
  entityId?: string;
  details?: Record<string, unknown>;
}) {
  try {
    const supabase = await createClient();
    await supabase.from("admin_activity_logs").insert({
      admin_id: opts.adminId,
      action: opts.action,
      entity_type: opts.entityType ?? null,
      entity_id: opts.entityId ?? null,
      details: opts.details ?? null,
    });
  } catch {
    // Logging must never break the action being logged.
  }
}

===== src\lib\admin-helpers.ts =====
/** Small display helpers for admin screens. Dates are shown in Indian time. */

const TZ = "Asia/Kolkata";

export function formatDate(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!value) return "";
  const d = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return "";
  return d.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric", timeZone: TZ });
}

export function formatDateTime(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!value) return "";
  const d = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return "";
  return d.toLocaleString("en-IN", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "numeric",
    minute: "2-digit",
    timeZone: TZ,
  });
}

/** Today's date as YYYY-MM-DD in Indian time (to compare with date columns). */
export function todayIST(): string {
  return new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-CA", { timeZone: TZ });
}

export function telLink(phone: string): string {
  return `tel:${phone.replace(/[^+0-9]/g, "")}`;
}

/** wa.me link. A 10 digit Indian number gets the 91 country code. */
export function whatsappLink(phone: string): string {
  let digits = phone.replace(/\D/g, "");
  if (digits.length === 11 && digits.startsWith("0")) digits = digits.slice(1);
  if (digits.length === 10) digits = `91${digits}`;
  return `https://wa.me/${digits}`;
}

  new: "New",

  contacted: "Contacted",
  selected: "Selected",
  rejected: "Rejected",
};

export function enquiryTone(status: string): Tone {
  if (status === "new") return "warn";
  if (status === "confirmed" || status === "in_progress" || status === "completed") return "good";
  return "neutral";
}

export function applicationTone(status: string): Tone {
  if (status === "new") return "warn";
  if (status === "selected") return "good";
  return "neutral";
}

export function optionsFrom(values: readonly string[], labels: Record<string, string>) {
  return values.map((value) => ({ value, label: labels[value] ?? value }));
}

===== src\lib\auth.ts =====
import "server-only";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { isSupabaseConfigured } from "@/lib/supabase/env";

export type AdminSession = {
  userId: string;
  email: string;
  fullName: string | null;
  role: "admin" | "super_admin";
};

/**
 * Verifies on the SERVER that the current user is an active admin.
 * Uses auth.getUser() (checked with Supabase), not just the cookie contents.
 * The database enforces the same rule again through RLS.
 */
export async function getAdminSession(): Promise<AdminSession | null> {
  if (!isSupabaseConfigured()) return null;
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (error || !data.user) return null;

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role, is_active, full_name")
    .eq("id", data.user.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!profile || !profile.is_active) return null;
  if (profile.role !== "admin" && profile.role !== "super_admin") return null;

  return {
    userId: data.user.id,
    email: data.user.email ?? "",
    fullName: profile.full_name,
    role: profile.role,
  };
}

/** Call at the top of every admin page and every admin server action. */
export async function requireAdmin(): Promise<AdminSession> {
  const session = await getAdminSession();
  if (!session) redirect("/admin/login");
  return session;
}

===== src\lib\business-settings.ts =====
import { createPublicClient } from "@/lib/supabase/public";

/**
 * Business settings.
 * Order of priority: value saved in admin (database) -> .env.local value -> placeholder.
 * Only public-safe fields are read here (RLS allows anyone to read business_settings).
 */

export type FeatureFlags = {
  before_after: boolean;
  faq: boolean;
  favourites: boolean;
  video_gallery: boolean;
  referral: boolean;
  seasonal_offers: boolean;
  estimator: boolean;
  customer_accounts: boolean;
};

export type BusinessSettings = {
  name: string;
  tagline: string;
  phoneDisplay: string;
  phoneTel: string; // digits with country code, used for tel: links
  whatsappNumber: string; // digits only, country code first, no +
  email: string;
  address: string;
  workingHours: string;
  mapEmbedUrl: string;
  siteUrl: string;
  features: FeatureFlags;
  /** true when real phone / WhatsApp / email have not been supplied yet */
  usingPlaceholders: boolean;
};

const PLACEHOLDER_PHONE = "[Add phone number]";
const PLACEHOLDER_EMAIL = "[Add email address]";
const PLACEHOLDER_ADDRESS = "[Add business address]";
const PLACEHOLDER_HOURS = "[Add working hours]";

const DEFAULT_FEATURES: FeatureFlags = {
  before_after: true,
  faq: true,
  favourites: true,
  video_gallery: false,
  referral: false,
  seasonal_offers: false,
  estimator: false,
  customer_accounts: false,
};

const digits = (v: string | null | undefined) => (v ?? "").replace(/\D/g, "");
const pick = (...values: Array<string | null | undefined>) =>
  values.map((v) => v?.trim()).find((v) => v) ?? "";

type DbRow = {
  business_name: string | null;
  tagline: string | null;
  phone: string | null;
  whatsapp_number: string | null;
  email: string | null;
  address: string | null;
  working_hours: string | null;
  map_embed_url: string | null;
  features: Partial<FeatureFlags> | null;
};

async function readFromDatabase(): Promise<DbRow | null> {
  try {
    const supabase = createPublicClient();
    if (!supabase) return null;
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("business_settings")
      .select(
        "business_name, tagline, phone, whatsapp_number, email, address, working_hours, map_embed_url, features",
      )
      .eq("id", true)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (error) return null;
    return data as DbRow | null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function getBusinessSettings(): Promise<BusinessSettings> {
  const db = await readFromDatabase();

  const phone = pick(db?.phone, process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BUSINESS_PHONE);
  const rawWhatsapp = digits(pick(db?.whatsapp_number, process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_WHATSAPP_NUMBER));
  // A 10-digit Indian mobile number needs the country code 91 for WhatsApp links.
  const whatsapp = rawWhatsapp.length === 10 ? `91${rawWhatsapp}` : rawWhatsapp;
  const email = pick(db?.email, process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BUSINESS_EMAIL);
  const address = pick(db?.address, process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BUSINESS_ADDRESS);
  const hours = pick(db?.working_hours, process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_WORKING_HOURS);

  return {
    name: pick(db?.business_name) || "Shree Krishna Enterprises",
    tagline: pick(db?.tagline) || "Transforming Spaces with Beautiful POP & PVC Designs",
    phoneDisplay: phone || PLACEHOLDER_PHONE,
    phoneTel: digits(phone),
    whatsappNumber: whatsapp,
    email: email || PLACEHOLDER_EMAIL,
    address: address || PLACEHOLDER_ADDRESS,
    workingHours: hours || PLACEHOLDER_HOURS,
    mapEmbedUrl: pick(db?.map_embed_url),
    siteUrl: (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000").replace(/\/$/, ""),
    features: { ...DEFAULT_FEATURES, ...(db?.features ?? {}) },
    usingPlaceholders: !phone || !whatsapp || !email,
  };
}

export const hasEmail = (s: BusinessSettings) => s.email !== PLACEHOLDER_EMAIL;
export const hasAddress = (s: BusinessSettings) => s.address !== PLACEHOLDER_ADDRESS;
export const hasHours = (s: BusinessSettings) => s.workingHours !== PLACEHOLDER_HOURS;

/** tel: link for the business phone, or undefined while it is still a placeholder. */
export function telHref(s: BusinessSettings): string | undefined {
  if (!s.phoneTel) return undefined;
  return s.phoneDisplay.trim().startsWith("+") ? `tel:+${s.phoneTel}` : `tel:${s.phoneTel}`;
}

===== src\lib\client-ip.ts =====
import "server-only";
import { headers } from "next/headers";

/** Visitor IP as set by the hosting platform (Vercel). Null when it cannot be read. */
export async function getClientIp(): Promise<string | null> {
  const h = await headers();
  const forwarded = h.get("x-forwarded-for");
  const ip = (forwarded?.split(",")[0] ?? h.get("x-real-ip") ?? "").trim();
  return ip && ip.length <= 64 ? ip : null;
}

===== src\lib\compress-image.ts =====
/**
 * Runs in the browser. Shrinks a phone photo before upload so that the form is quick,
 * uses little mobile data, and stays under the hosting size limit.
 * Throws if the browser cannot read the file.
 */
const STEPS: Array<{ edge: number; quality: number }> = [
  { edge: 1600, quality: 0.8 },
  { edge: 1280, quality: 0.7 },
  { edge: 1024, quality: 0.6 },
];
const TARGET_BYTES = 1_200_000;

export async function compressImage(file: File): Promise<File> {
  if (!/^image\/(jpeg|png|webp)$/.test(file.type)) throw new Error("Unsupported photo type");

  const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(file, { imageOrientation: "from-image" });
  try {
    let blob: Blob | null = null;
    for (const step of STEPS) {
      const scale = Math.min(1, step.edge / Math.max(bitmap.width, bitmap.height));
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.width * scale));
      canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.height * scale));
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      if (!ctx) throw new Error("No canvas");
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff"; // PNG transparency becomes white instead of black
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      ctx.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      blob = await new Promise<Blob | null>((resolve) => canvas.toBlob(resolve, "image/jpeg", step.quality));
      if (blob && blob.size <= TARGET_BYTES) break;
    }
    if (!blob) throw new Error("Could not compress");
    const base = file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "") || "photo";
    return new File([blob], `${base}.jpg`, { type: "image/jpeg" });
  } finally {
    bitmap.close();
  }
}

===== src\lib\content.ts =====
import { cache } from "react";
import type { SupabaseClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { createPublicClient } from "@/lib/supabase/public";
import type {
  Category,
  Design,
  Faq,
  Inspiration,
  Project,
  Review,
  Service,
  ServiceArea,
} from "@/lib/types";

/**
 * Read-only queries for the public website.
 * They use the anonymous key, so the database (RLS) only returns published/approved rows.
 * `failed` is true when the database could not be reached, so pages can show an error
 * instead of pretending there is no content.
 */
export type Result<T> = { data: T; failed: boolean };

async function run<T>(
  empty: T,
  query: (sb: SupabaseClient) => PromiseLike<{ data: unknown; error: unknown }>,
): Promise<Result<T>> {
  const sb = createPublicClient();
  if (!sb) return { data: empty, failed: false }; // Supabase not connected yet: behave as empty
  try {
    const { data, error } = await query(sb);
    if (error) return { data: empty, failed: true };
    return { data: (data ?? empty) as T, failed: false };
  } catch {
    return { data: empty, failed: true };
  }
}

export const byOrder = <T extends { sort_order: number }>(items: T[]) =>
  [...items].sort((a, b) => a.sort_order - b.sort_order);

===== src\lib\customer-upload.ts =====
import "server-only";
import { createServiceClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import { MAX_PHOTOS } from "@/lib/enquiry-options";

/** Customer photos go to the PRIVATE bucket "customer-uploads". Only admins can open them. */
const BUCKET = "customer-uploads";
const MAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;

type Detected = { ext: string; type: string };
export type ValidPhoto = { bytes: Uint8Array; ext: string; type: string };

const ascii = (b: Uint8Array, from: number, to: number) => String.fromCharCode(...b.slice(from, to));

/** Looks at the first bytes of the file. The browser-supplied file type is not trusted. */
function detect(b: Uint8Array): Detected | null {
  if (b.length < 12) return null;
  if (b[0] === 0xff && b[1] === 0xd8 && b[2] === 0xff) return { ext: "jpg", type: "image/jpeg" };
  if (b[0] === 0x89 && ascii(b, 1, 4) === "PNG") return { ext: "png", type: "image/png" };
  if (ascii(b, 0, 4) === "RIFF" && ascii(b, 8, 12) === "WEBP") return { ext: "webp", type: "image/webp" };
  if (ascii(b, 4, 8) === "ftyp" && /^(heic|heix|hevc|heim|mif1|heif)/.test(ascii(b, 8, 12))) {
    return { ext: "heic", type: "image/heic" };
  }
  return null;
}

export function filesFrom(formData: FormData, name = "photos"): File[] {
  return formData.getAll(name).filter((f): f is File => f instanceof File && f.size > 0);
}

/** Checks count, size and real file type. Nothing is stored yet. */
export async function readPhotos(files: File[]): Promise<{ photos: ValidPhoto[] } | { error: string }> {
  if (files.length > MAX_PHOTOS) return { error: `You can add up to ${MAX_PHOTOS} photos.` };
  const photos: ValidPhoto[] = [];
  for (const file of files) {
    if (file.size > MAX_BYTES) return { error: "Each photo must be smaller than 5 MB." };
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer());
    const kind = detect(bytes);
    if (!kind) return { error: "Use JPG, PNG or WEBP photos only." };
    photos.push({ bytes, ext: kind.ext, type: kind.type });
  }
  return { photos };
}

/** Saves photos under `folder` and returns the paths that were saved. A failed photo is skipped. */
export async function storePhotos(folder: string, photos: ValidPhoto[]): Promise<string[]> {
  const saved: string[] = [];
  if (photos.length === 0) return saved;
  const sb = createServiceClient();
  const safeFolder = folder.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9/_-]/g, "-");
  for (const p of photos) {
    const path = `${safeFolder}/${crypto.randomUUID()}.${p.ext}`;
    const { error } = await sb.storage.from(BUCKET).upload(path, p.bytes, { contentType: p.type, upsert: false });
    if (!error) saved.push(path);
  }
  return saved;
}

===== src\lib\enquiry-submit.ts =====
import "server-only";
import { z } from "zod";
import { cleanText } from "@/lib/sanitize";
import { createServiceClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import { checkRateLimit } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { getClientIp } from "@/lib/client-ip";
import { filesFrom, readPhotos, storePhotos } from "@/lib/customer-upload";
import { todayIST } from "@/lib/admin-helpers";
import { ROOM_TYPES } from "@/lib/enquiry-options";
import type { PublicFormState } from "@/lib/public-form-state";

type Mode = "quote" | "custom";

const optional = (re: RegExp, message: string) => z.string().refine((v) => v === "" || re.test(v), message);

const dimension = z
  .string()
  .refine((v) => v === "" || /^\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(v), "Enter a number, for example 12 or 12.5.")
  .refine((v) => v === "" || Number(v) > 0, "Enter a number above 0.");

function inOneYear(): string {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setFullYear(d.getFullYear() + 1);
  return d.toLocaleDateString("en-CA", { timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata" });
}

function buildSchema(mode: Mode) {
  return z.object({
    name: z.string().min(2, "Enter your name.").max(100),
    phone: z.string().regex(/^\+?[0-9]{10,13}$/, "Enter a valid phone number, for example 98765 43210."),
    email: z
      .string()
      .max(120)
      .refine((v) => v === "" || z.email().safeParse(v).success, "Enter a valid email address."),
    address: z.string().max(500),
    service_type: z.string().max(100),
    room_type: z.string().refine((v) => v === "" || (ROOM_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(v), "Choose a room."),
    style: z.string().max(60),
    budget_range: z.string().max(60),
    description:
      mode === "custom"
        ? z.string().min(10, "Tell us a little about the design you want.").max(4000)
        : z.string().max(4000),
    preferred_visit_date: optional(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/, "Choose a valid date.").refine(
      (v) => v === "" || (v >= todayIST() && v <= inOneYear()),
      "Choose a date from today up to one year ahead.",
    ),
    length_ft: dimension,
    width_ft: dimension,
    privacy_consent: z.boolean().refine((v) => v, "Please tick this box to continue."),
  });
}

const GENERIC_ERROR =
  "We could not send your request right now. Please try again in a moment, or call or WhatsApp us.";

/**
 * Handles the Quote form and the Custom Design form.
 * Order: spam trap, validation, photo check, rate limit, save enquiry, save photos.
 */
export async function submitEnquiry(mode: Mode, formData: FormData): Promise<PublicFormState> {
  const text = (key: string, max: number) => cleanText(formData.get(key), max);

  // Hidden field that only bots fill in. Pretend it worked.
  if (text("hp_note", 200)) return { ok: true, message: "Thank you." };

  const typed = {
    name: text("name", 100),
    phone: text("phone", 30),
    email: text("email", 120),
    address: text("address", 500),
    service_type: text("service_type", 100),
    room_type: text("room_type", 40),
    style: text("style", 60),
    budget_range: text("budget_range", 60),
    description: text("description", 4000),
    preferred_visit_date: text("preferred_visit_date", 10),
    length_ft: text("length_ft", 10),
    width_ft: text("width_ft", 10),
    privacy_consent: formData.get("privacy_consent") === "on",
  };
  const designSlug = text("design", 120);
  const values: Record<string, string> = {
    ...typed,
    privacy_consent: typed.privacy_consent ? "on" : "",
  };

  const parsed = buildSchema(mode).safeParse({ ...typed, phone: typed.phone.replace(/[\s()-]/g, "") });
  if (!parsed.success) {
    const fieldErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) fieldErrors[String(issue.path[0])] ??= issue.message;
    return { ok: false, message: "Please fix the highlighted fields.", fieldErrors, values };
  }
  const d = parsed.data;

  const checked = await readPhotos(filesFrom(formData));
  if ("error" in checked) {
    return { ok: false, message: checked.error, fieldErrors: { photos: checked.error }, values };
  }

  // Limits per visitor and per phone number.
  const ip = await getClientIp();
  const allowedByIp = ip ? await checkRateLimit(`enquiry:ip:${ip}`, 6, 60 * 60) : true;
  const allowedByPhone = await checkRateLimit(`enquiry:phone:${d.phone}`, 3, 24 * 60 * 60);
  if (!allowedByIp || !allowedByPhone) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "You have already sent a few requests. Please wait a while, or call or WhatsApp us.",
      values,
    };
  }

  try {
    const sb = createServiceClient();

    let designId: string | null = null;
    if (mode === "custom" && designSlug) {
      const { data: design } = await sb
        .from("designs")
        .select("id")
        .eq("slug", designSlug)
        .eq("is_published", true)
        .maybeSingle();
      designId = design?.id ?? null;
    }

    const { data: enquiry, error } = await sb
      .from("enquiries")
      .insert({
        kind: mode === "quote" ? "quotation" : designId ? "design" : "custom_design",
        name: d.name,
        phone: d.phone,
        email: d.email || null,
        address: d.address || null,
        service_type: d.service_type || null,
        room_type: d.room_type || null,
        style: d.style || null,
        budget_range: d.budget_range || null,
        description: d.description || null,
        preferred_visit_date: d.preferred_visit_date || null,
        length_ft: d.length_ft ? Number(d.length_ft) : null,
        width_ft: d.width_ft ? Number(d.width_ft) : null,
        design_id: designId,
        privacy_consent: true,
      })
      .select("id, ref_code")
      .single();
    if (error || !enquiry) return { ok: false, message: GENERIC_ERROR, values };

    let photoNote = "";
    if (checked.photos.length > 0) {
      const saved = await storePhotos(`enquiries/${enquiry.id}`, checked.photos);
      if (saved.length > 0) {
        await sb
          .from("enquiry_images")
          .insert(saved.map((storage_path) => ({ enquiry_id: enquiry.id, storage_path })));
      }
      if (saved.length < checked.photos.length) {
        photoNote = " Some photos could not be uploaded. You can send them to us on WhatsApp.";
      }
    }

    return {
      ok: true,
      message: `Thank you. We have received your request.${photoNote}`,
      refCode: enquiry.ref_code,
    };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, message: GENERIC_ERROR, values };
  }
}

===== src\lib\favourites.ts =====
"use client";

import { useMemo, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";

// Saved designs for visitors who are not logged in. Stored only in their own browser.
const KEY = "ske-favourites";
const EVENT = "ske-favourites-change";

function readRaw(): string {
  try {
    return window.localStorage.getItem(KEY) ?? "[]";
  } catch {
    return "[]";
  }
}

function subscribe(callback: () => void) {
  window.addEventListener("storage", callback);
  window.addEventListener(EVENT, callback);
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener("storage", callback);
    window.removeEventListener(EVENT, callback);
  };
}

export function useFavourites(): string[] {
  const raw = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, readRaw, () => "[]");
  return useMemo(() => {
    try {
      const value: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
      return Array.isArray(value) ? value.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === "string") : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }, [raw]);
}

export function toggleFavourite(slug: string) {
  try {
    const current: string[] = JSON.parse(readRaw());
    const next = current.includes(slug) ? current.filter((s) => s !== slug) : [...current, slug];
    window.localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(next.slice(0, 200)));
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event(EVENT));
  } catch {
    // Storage blocked (private mode): saving silently does nothing.
  }
}

===== src\lib\notify-templates.ts =====
import { ENQUIRY_STATUS_LABELS } from "@/lib/admin-status";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/admin-helpers";

export type NotifyEnquiry = {
  name: string;
  ref_code: string;
  service_type: string | null;
  preferred_visit_date: string | null;
};

/**
 * One ready-to-edit WhatsApp message per status, in plain, polite English.
 * Admin can still change the words before sending; nothing is sent automatically.
 */
export function buildStatusMessage(status: string, businessName: string, e: NotifyEnquiry): string {
  const firstName = e.name.split(" ")[0] || e.name;
  const visitDate = formatDate(e.preferred_visit_date);
  const work = e.service_type ? ` for ${e.service_type}` : "";

  switch (status) {
    case "new":
      return `Hello ${firstName}, this is ${businessName}. We have received your request (${e.ref_code}). We will contact you shortly.`;
    case "contacted":
      return `Hello ${firstName}, this is ${businessName}. Thank you for speaking with us about your request (${e.ref_code}). Please let us know if you have any questions.`;
    case "site_visit":
      return visitDate
        ? `Hello ${firstName}, this is ${businessName}. We will visit your site on ${visitDate} for your request${work} (${e.ref_code}). Please let us know if this time does not work for you.`
        : `Hello ${firstName}, this is ${businessName}. We would like to visit your site to see the work needed${work} (${e.ref_code}). Please let us know a convenient date and time.`;
    case "quotation_sent":
      return `Hello ${firstName}, this is ${businessName}. We have prepared your quotation for ${e.ref_code}. Please check and let us know if you would like to proceed.`;
    case "confirmed":
      return `Hello ${firstName}, this is ${businessName}. Your work order (${e.ref_code}) is confirmed. We will share the start date soon.`;
    case "in_progress":
      return `Hello ${firstName}, this is ${businessName}. Your work (${e.ref_code}) is now in progress. We will keep you updated.`;
    case "completed":
      return `Hello ${firstName}, this is ${businessName}. Your work (${e.ref_code}) is now complete. Thank you for choosing us. We would be grateful if you could share a review on our website.`;
    case "closed":
      return `Hello ${firstName}, this is ${businessName}. Regarding your request (${e.ref_code}): please contact us if you need anything further.`;
    default:
      return `Hello ${firstName}, this is ${businessName}, regarding your request (${e.ref_code}).`;
  }
}

===== src\lib\private-files.ts =====
import "server-only";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";

/**
 * Customer photos (enquiries, applications, reviews) live in the PRIVATE bucket "customer-uploads".
 * These helpers run as the logged-in admin; the storage policy allows admins only.
 */
const BUCKET = "customer-uploads";

/** Returns path -> temporary URL (valid for one hour). Missing files are simply left out. */
export async function signedUrlsFor(paths: string[]): Promise<Map<string, string>> {
  const result = new Map<string, string>();
  const unique = Array.from(new Set(paths.filter(Boolean)));
  if (unique.length === 0) return result;
  try {
    const sb = await createClient();
    const { data } = await sb.storage.from(BUCKET).createSignedUrls(unique, 60 * 60);
    for (const item of data ?? []) {
      if (item.path && item.signedUrl) result.set(item.path, item.signedUrl);
    }
  } catch {
    // Photos are optional context. The page still works without them.
  }
  return result;
}

/** Best effort delete. Never throws. */
export async function removePrivateFiles(paths: string[]) {
  const unique = Array.from(new Set(paths.filter(Boolean)));
  if (unique.length === 0) return;
  try {
    const sb = await createClient();
    await sb.storage.from(BUCKET).remove(unique);
  } catch {
    // best effort
  }
}

===== src\lib\rate-limit.ts =====
import "server-only";
import { createServiceClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";

/**
 * Counts one hit for `key` and returns true while the visitor is still under the limit.
 * Uses the database function check_rate_limit (service role only).
 * If the limiter itself breaks, it lets the request through so real customers are never locked out.
 */
export async function checkRateLimit(key: string, max: number, windowSeconds: number): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const sb = createServiceClient();
    const { data, error } = await sb.rpc("check_rate_limit", {
      p_key: key,
      p_max: max,
      p_window_seconds: windowSeconds,
    });
    if (error) return true;
    return data === true;
  } catch {
    return true;
  }
}

===== src\lib\sanitize.ts =====
/** Trims, removes control characters and angle brackets from free text. React also escapes output. */
export function cleanText(value: unknown, maxLength = 500): string {
  if (typeof value !== "string") return "";
  return value
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u0008\u000B\u000C\u000E-\u001F\u007F]/g, "")
    .replace(/[<>]/g, "")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);
}

===== src\lib\seo.ts =====
import type { Metadata } from "next";

/** Same metadata shape for every page: title, description, canonical, Open Graph. */
export function pageMetadata(opts: {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  path: string;
  image?: string | null;
  noindex?: boolean;
}): Metadata {
  return {
    title: opts.title,
    description: opts.description,
    alternates: { canonical: opts.path },
    openGraph: {
      title: opts.title,
      description: opts.description,
      url: opts.path,
      ...(opts.image ? { images: [{ url: opts.image }] } : {}),
    },
    ...(opts.noindex ? { robots: { index: false, follow: false } } : {}),
  };
}

===== src\lib\slug.ts =====
/** "POP False Ceiling" -> "pop-false-ceiling". Matches the slug check in the database. */
export function slugify(input: string): string {
  return input
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "")
    .slice(0, 80);
}

===== src\lib\storage.ts =====
import { getSupabaseEnv } from "@/lib/supabase/env";

/**
 * Public URL of a photo in the "public-media" bucket.
 * `path` is the path saved in the database (for example "projects/living-room/1.jpg").
 */
export function publicMediaUrl(path: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!path) return null;
  const env = getSupabaseEnv();
  if (!env) return null;
  const clean = path
    .replace(/^\/+/, "")
    .split("/")
    .map(encodeURIComponent)
    .join("/");
  return `${env.url}/storage/v1/object/public/public-media/${clean}`;
}

===== src\lib\upload.ts =====
import "server-only";
import { createServiceClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";

const ALLOWED_TYPES = new Set(["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp", "image/avif"]);
const MAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;

export type UploadResult = { path: string } | { error: string };

/**
 * Validates and uploads one admin photo to the public "public-media" bucket.
 * `folder` groups files, e.g. "projects/<project-id>".
 */
export async function uploadPublicImage(file: File, folder: string): Promise<UploadResult> {
  if (!file || file.size === 0) return { error: "Choose an image to upload." };
  if (!ALLOWED_TYPES.has(file.type)) return { error: "Use a JPG, PNG, WEBP or AVIF image." };
  if (file.size > MAX_BYTES) return { error: "Image must be smaller than 5 MB." };

  const ext = file.type === "image/jpeg" ? "jpg" : file.type.split("/")[1];
  const safeFolder = folder.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9/_-]/g, "-");
  const path = `${safeFolder}/${crypto.randomUUID()}.${ext}`;

  const supabase = createServiceClient();
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer());
  const { error } = await supabase.storage
    .from("public-media")
    .upload(path, bytes, { contentType: file.type, upsert: false });

  if (error) return { error: "Upload failed. Try again." };
  return { path };
}

/** Deletes a photo from "public-media". Never throws: a missing file is not a user-facing error. */
export async function deletePublicImage(path: string | null | undefined) {
  if (!path) return;
  try {
    await createServiceClient().storage.from("public-media").remove([path]);
  } catch {
    // best effort
  }
}

===== src\lib\video.ts =====
/** Turns a YouTube or Vimeo link into a safe embed URL. Anything else returns null. */
export function toEmbedUrl(raw: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  let u: URL;
  try {
    u = new URL(raw);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  if (u.protocol !== "https:") return null;
  const host = u.hostname.replace(/^www\./, "");

  if (host === "youtu.be") {
    const id = u.pathname.slice(1);
    return /^[\w-]{6,20}$/.test(id) ? `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${id}` : null;
  }
  if (host === "youtube.com" || host === "m.youtube.com") {
    const id = u.searchParams.get("v") ?? u.pathname.match(/^\/embed\/([\w-]{6,20})/)?.[1] ?? null;
    return id && /^[\w-]{6,20}$/.test(id) ? `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${id}` : null;
  }
  if (host === "vimeo.com") {
    const id = u.pathname.match(/^\/(\d{5,12})/)?.[1];
    return id ? `https://player.vimeo.com/video/${id}` : null;
  }
  return null;
}

/** Official Pinterest pin embed from a pin link like https://www.pinterest.com/pin/1234567890/ */
export function toPinterestEmbed(raw: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  const id = raw.match(/pinterest\.[a-z.]+\/pin\/(\d{5,25})/i)?.[1];
  return id ? `https://assets.pinterest.com/ext/embed.html?id=${id}` : null;
}

===== src\lib\whatsapp.ts =====
/**
 * WhatsApp helpers.
 * If no business number is configured, the link falls back to wa.me/?text=
 * which opens WhatsApp's contact chooser, so the button never breaks.
 */

type EnquiryKind = "design" | "project" | "service" | "general";

export function buildWhatsAppLink(opts: {
  whatsappNumber: string;
  message: string;
}): string {
  const number = opts.whatsappNumber.replace(/\D/g, "");
  const text = encodeURIComponent(opts.message);
  return number ? `https://wa.me/${number}?text=${text}` : `https://wa.me/?text=${text}`;
}

/** Builds the prefilled message for an item enquiry (design, project, service). */
export function buildEnquiryMessage(opts: {
  kind: EnquiryKind;
  itemName?: string;
  url?: string;
}): string {
  const { kind, itemName, url } = opts;
  if (kind === "general" || !itemName) {
    return "Hello Shree Krishna Enterprises, I would like to enquire about your POP / PVC work.";
  }
  const label =
    kind === "design" ? "design" : kind === "project" ? "project" : "service";
  const lines = [
    `Hello Shree Krishna Enterprises, I am interested in this ${label}: ${itemName}.`,
  ];
  if (url) lines.push(`Link: ${url}`);
  lines.push("Please share more details.");
  return lines.join("\n");
}

===== src\lib\supabase\admin.ts =====
import "server-only";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

/**
 * Service-role client. BYPASSES Row Level Security.
 * `server-only` makes the build fail if this file is ever imported in browser code.
 * Use only inside server actions / route handlers, after validating the input.
 */
export function createServiceClient() {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  const key = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY ?? process.env.SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY;
  if (!url || !key) throw new Error("Service role key is not configured on the server.");
  return createClient(url, key, { auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false } });
}

===== src\lib\supabase\client.ts =====
import { createBrowserClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { getSupabaseEnv } from "./env";

/** Browser Supabase client. Uses only the public anon/publishable key. */
export function createClient() {
  const env = getSupabaseEnv();
  if (!env) {
    throw new Error(
      "Supabase is not configured. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in .env.local",
    );
  }
  return createBrowserClient(env.url, env.anonKey);
}

===== src\lib\supabase\env.ts =====
/** Reads Supabase settings. Accepts the legacy "anon" key or the newer "publishable" key. */
export function getSupabaseEnv() {
  const rawUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL?.trim();
  const anonKey = (
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY ??
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
  )?.trim();
  if (!rawUrl || !anonKey) return null;

  // Keep only https://xxxx.supabase.co and drop any extra path like /rest/v1/
  let url: string;
  try {
    url = new URL(rawUrl).origin;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  return { url, anonKey };
}

export const isSupabaseConfigured = () => getSupabaseEnv() !== null;

===== src\lib\supabase\public.ts =====
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { getSupabaseEnv } from "./env";

/** Anonymous server client for public pages. No cookies, so pages can be cached. */
export function createPublicClient() {
  const env = getSupabaseEnv();
  if (!env) return null;
  return createClient(env.url, env.anonKey, {
    auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
  });
}

/** Helper to get public URL for files in public-media bucket */
export function getPublicMediaUrl(path: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!path) return null;
  if (path.startsWith("http://") || path.startsWith("https://")) return path;
  const env = getSupabaseEnv();
  if (!env) return null;
  return `${env.url}/storage/v1/object/public/public-media/${path.replace(/^\//, "")}`;
}


===== src\lib\supabase\server.ts =====
import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { getSupabaseEnv } from "./env";

/** Server Supabase client that acts as the logged-in user (RLS applies). */
export async function createClient() {
  const env = getSupabaseEnv();
  if (!env) throw new Error("Supabase is not configured.");
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  return createServerClient(env.url, env.anonKey, {
    cookies: {
      getAll: () => cookieStore.getAll(),
      setAll(list) {
        try {
          list.forEach(({ name, value, options }) => cookieStore.set(name, value, options));
        } catch {
          // Called from a Server Component: cookies are refreshed in proxy.ts instead.
        }
      },
    },
  });
}
